<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Add a Hopper (SM90) backend to DeepSeek-V4.1's specialized decode executor (#61868), for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at TP4 on H200 with DSpark k=5. It is opt-in, as on GB300, through `--additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}'`. Decode steps of up to 192 rows run in the executor; larger steps, prefill and anything it does not serve fall back to the stock path over the same weights.

Stacked on #61869 (DSpark low-latency decode), #57770 (split-vocabulary greedy argmax) and #64892 (SM90 mHC overlap behind the fused all-reduce). Pure TP4 with Humming MoE also needs humming#177 (humming-kernels 0.1.19, #64802).

**Reviewing:** the Hopper executor commit is the new work, plus the merge of main on top of it, which adapts the stack to main's `DraftLogitsCache` and the moved CuTe DSL primitives. Everything before them comes from #61869 and #64892. #57770 is merged in main. #61869 is still open, so its changes are in this diff until it lands.

**Duplicate check:** there is no other open Hopper backend for the specialized decode. #62958 and #64442 only touch DSpark sampling.

## Claims

- Median ITL on H200 TP4, DSpark k=5, on this branch merged with main: −38% at c1 (8.65 → 5.34 ms) and about −5% at c8 on real prompts; −37% at c1 and −14% at c8 at 64K context. At c16 and above the gain was about 5–7% before the merge and has not been re-measured since.
- Quality is unchanged within noise on GPQA-Diamond, AIME25 and 128K needle retrieval; greedy logprob drift is within the stock run-to-run floor.
- No host syncs in steady-state decode (`VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`, re-run on the merged build: 0 at c1, c8 and c32).
- The Hopper commit changes no core components (model runner, scheduler, KV cache manager); the `model_runner.py` changes in this diff come from #61869. Everything in the Hopper commit is under `vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/specialized_decode/`, and SM100 behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

Setup: 4× H200, `--tensor-parallel-size 4 --max-model-len 200000 --max-num-seqs 64`, DSpark k=5, Humming MoE with humming#177. "Off" is the same build with the executor disabled, so it includes every stacked PR. Runs are in ABBA order (on, off, off, on).

**Speed, real prompts, output length 1024, temperature 0.7.** Median ITL in ms:

| conc | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 24 | 32 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| executor off | 8.76 | 10.31 | 12.81 | 16.49 | 21.26 | 26.61 | 29.83 |
| executor on | 5.40 | 6.88 | 10.57 | 14.27 | 19.84 | 25.02 | 28.31 |
| Δ | −38.3% | −33.3% | −17.5% | −13.5% | −6.6% | −6.0% | −5.1% |

Acceptance lengths match between arms (2.79–3.15).

**Long context, 64K prompts, two on/off pairs.** Median ITL in ms:

| conc | on | off | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 5.64, 5.65 | 8.96, 8.96 | −37% |
| 8 | 15.20, 13.58 | 15.59, 16.15 | about −9% |

**Quality.**

| Eval | on | off | on − off (paired) |
|---|---|---|---|
| GPQA-Diamond, 8 × 198 | 79.9 | 80.6 | −0.6 ± 0.6 |
| AIME25, 8 × 30 | 86.2 | 85.8 | +0.4 ± 1.8 |
| 128K needle, single and multikey, c1 and c8 | 12/12 each | 12/12 each | |

- On the final build, GPQA-Diamond at 3 repeats scores 80.0.
- Greedy logprobs at identical prefixes, 24 prompts:
  - on vs off: mean |Δ logprob| on the chosen token 2.2e-2;
  - off vs off (noise floor): 2.6e-2;
  - every divergence happens at a top-1 margin of at most 0.25 nats.

The concurrency sweep and the 8-repeat evals ran before a fused-indexer fix at long context. On the final build c1 and c8 measure 5.39 and 14.40 ms, unchanged.

**After merging main (`f1df4a3ae9`).** Median ITL in ms, on a new 160-prompt set from `RedHatAI/speculator_benchmarks`:

| Point | on | off | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| real prompts, c1 | 5.34 | 8.64, 8.66 | −38% |
| real prompts, c8 | 14.36 | 14.64, 15.65 | about −5% |
| 64K context, c1 | 5.63 | 8.89 | −37% |
| 64K context, c8 | 13.63 | 15.93 | −14% |

| Check | on | off |
|---|---|---|
| 128K needle, single and multikey, c1 and c8 | 12/12 each | 12/12 each |
| GPQA-Diamond, 3 repeats | 79.3 (80.3 / 79.3 / 78.3) | not re-run |

Only one on run per point is clean. The tables above this one are from before the merge and used an earlier prompt set, so compare numbers only within a table. The c8 gain is smaller here than the −13.5% in the sweep above. The cause isn't established: main, the prompt set and acceptance length (3.25 on, 3.18–3.50 off) all changed, and the runs are few. A clean c1–c32 sweep on the merged build is still to do; the attempt so far overlapped other work on the GPUs and was discarded.

**Tests.** `pytest tests/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/specialized_decode/test_hopper.py` on H200: 19 passed.
- The tests compare each Hopper kernel and step against the stock path or an FP32 reference.
- The fused indexer has a long-context case: one indexer shared across ratio-1 and ratio-2 layers, rows longer than the candidate coverage, and a NaN-poisoned output.
- `test_hopper` is wired into Buildkite (`models_basic.yaml`).
- CI has no 4× H200 runner for the end-to-end numbers above.

Reproduce:

```bash
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --max-model-len 200000 --max-num-seqs 64 --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5}'
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --endpoint /v1/completions --dataset-name custom \
  --dataset-path real_prompts.jsonl --skip-chat-template --custom-output-len 1024 \
  --temperature 0.7 --max-concurrency 1   # likewise 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32
```

The executor-on arm adds `--additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}'` to `vllm serve`. The executor-off arm is the default.

## Details

**Where the time goes.** At c1 the stock step is mostly fixed per-kernel cost, not bandwidth:
- an isolated ~10 MB GEMV reaches only about 50% of HBM;
- each kernel boundary costs ~0.7–1.8 µs.

So the executor:
- chains kernels with PDL;
- replaces the small-batch MoE, dense FP8 linears, sparse MLA and indexer with SM90 CuTe DSL kernels written for these shapes;
- fuses the small ops around them.

The MoE runs near its streaming limit (about 4 TB/s).

**Compatibility.** The kernels read the weights in stock's layouts:
- Humming MXFP4 × block-FP8 for experts;
- Humming W8A16 for dense layers.

So steps the executor doesn't serve fall back to stock with one copy of the weights. The exception is an FP8 copy of `wo_a`, because stock SM90 keeps it only as BF16. It costs about 0.36 GB per GPU (1.44 GB in FP8 across 43 layers, sharded TP4).

**Size.** About 10.8K lines under `hopper/`, mostly kernels:

| Area | Lines |
|---|---|
| MoE | 4.4K |
| sparse MLA | 2.3K |
| dense GEMM | 1.6K |
| indexer | 0.9K |
| attention-chain fusions | 0.7K |

Plus +342/−85 in the shared specialized-decode package, which lets the executor select its backend by architecture and records metadata builds for the Hopper builders. Plus 1.0K lines of tests.

It mirrors the GB300 backend's structure, so the two share the executor runtime, step schedule and fallbacks.

**Limitations.**
- TP4 on H200 only.
- Steps above 192 rows use stock.
- The gain shrinks with batch size, as the per-kernel overhead is amortized.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The Hopper executor's sparse-MLA decode
+(``specialized_decode/hopper/sparse_mla.py``) against the stock FlashMLA decode
+it replaces, on the FlashMLA SM90 kernel, eagerly and replayed from a CUDA
+graph. Needs one SM90 GPU; under a minute.
+
+Run: pytest -v tests/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/specialized_decode/test_hopper.py
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import ForwardContext, override_forward_context
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia import flashmla
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.flashmla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.hopper import sparse_mla
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_device_capability(90)),
+    reason="needs an SM90 GPU",
+)
+
+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+GROUPS = 2  # SWA KV-cache groups; layer i is in group i % GROUPS.
+# (compress_ratio, kv source, index source) per layer: two runs of index
+# sources per ratio, each run spanning both groups.
+LAYOUT = (
+    (0, None, None),
+    (0, None, None),
+    (2, 2, 2),
+    (2, 2, 2),
+    (2, 2, 4),
+    (2, 2, 4),
+    (1, 6, 6),
+    (1, 6, 6),
+    (1, 6, 8),
+    (1, 6, 8),
+)
+SEQ_LENS = (300, 2000)
+ROWS = 6  # DSpark: 6 verify rows a request
+TOKENS = ROWS * len(SEQ_LENS)
+# Padded heads; a TP4 rank's 16 local heads are the first.
+HEADS, LOCAL_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, WINDOW, TOP_K = 64, 16, 512, 128, 512
+# Cache pages of 64 entries, as on SM90: a compressed page holds 64 * ratio
+# tokens.
+PAGE = 64
+
+
+def _v4_cache(blocks: int, block_size: int, generator) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A V4 (584 B a token) FP8 cache of finite values: each block holds its
+    data rows (448 e4m3 NoPE values, 64 BF16 RoPE values), then its scale rows
+    (7 e8m0 scales and a pad byte)."""
+
+    def randn(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=generator, device=DEVICE)
+
+    nope = randn(blocks, block_size, 448).clamp(-6, 6).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    rope = randn(blocks, block_size, 64).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    scales = torch.randint(
+        125, 130, (blocks, block_size, 8), generator=generator, device=DEVICE
+    ).to(torch.uint8)
+    scales[..., 7] = 0
+    data = torch.cat([nope.view(torch.uint8), rope.view(torch.uint8)], dim=-1)
+    block = torch.cat([data.flatten(1), scales.flatten(1)], dim=-1)
+    return block.view(blocks, block_size, 584)
+
+
+class Step:
+    """One pure-decode step of ``LAYOUT``'s layers on random caches."""
+
+    def __init__(self, seed: int):
+        g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+        self.generator = g
+        positions = torch.cat(
+            [torch.arange(n - ROWS, n, device=DEVICE) for n in SEQ_LENS]
+        )
+        swa_lens = (positions + 1).clamp(max=WINDOW).to(torch.int32)
+        self.topk = torch.zeros(TOKENS, TOP_K, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+        self.layers: list[DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention] = []
+        self.by_layer: dict = {}
+        self.groups = []
+        for _ in range(GROUPS):
+            cache = _v4_cache(16, PAGE, g)
+            # Each group's own SWA slots, -1 past the window.
+            slots = torch.stack(
+                [torch.randperm(16 * PAGE, generator=g, device=DEVICE)[:WINDOW]]
+                * TOKENS
+            ).to(torch.int32)
+            columns = torch.arange(WINDOW, device=DEVICE)
+            slots[columns >= swa_lens[:, None]] = -1
+            self.groups.append(
+                SimpleNamespace(
+                    num_decodes=len(SEQ_LENS),
+                    num_prefills=0,
+                    num_decode_tokens=TOKENS,
+                    max_decode_query_len=ROWS,
+                    is_valid_token=torch.ones(TOKENS, dtype=torch.bool, device=DEVICE),
+                    token_to_req_indices=torch.arange(
+                        len(SEQ_LENS), dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE
+                    ).repeat_interleave(ROWS),
+                    decode_swa_indices=slots.unsqueeze(1),
+                    decode_swa_lens=swa_lens,
+                    kv_cache=cache,
+                )
+            )
+        self.compressed = {}
+        for kv_source in {kv for _, kv, _ in LAYOUT if kv is not None}:
+            ratio = LAYOUT[kv_source][0]
+            self.compressed[kv_source] = (
+                _v4_cache(64, PAGE, g),
+                SimpleNamespace(
+                    block_size=PAGE * ratio,
+                    block_table=torch.randperm(64, generator=g, device=DEVICE)
+                    .view(2, 32)
+                    .to(torch.int32),
+                ),
+            )
+            self.by_layer[f"layers.{kv_source}"] = self.compressed[kv_source][1]
+        for layer_id, (ratio, kv_source, index_source) in enumerate(LAYOUT):
+            group = self.groups[layer_id % GROUPS]
+            layer = object.__new__(DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention)
+            layer.compress_ratio = ratio
+            layer.n_local_heads, layer.padded_heads = LOCAL_HEADS, HEADS
+            layer.index_source_layer_id = index_source
+            layer.compressed_cache_prefix = (
+                None if kv_source is None else f"layers.{kv_source}"
+            )
+            layer.topk_indices_buffer = self.topk
+            layer.scale = HEAD_DIM**-0.5
+            layer.attn_sink = torch.randn(HEADS, generator=g, device=DEVICE)
+            prefix = f"layers.{layer_id}.swa_cache"
+            layer.swa_cache_layer = SimpleNamespace(
+                prefix=prefix, kv_cache=group.kv_cache
+            )
+            if kv_source is not None:
+                cache = self.compressed[kv_source][0]
+                layer._compressed_kv_cache = lambda cache=cache: cache
+            self.by_layer[prefix] = group
+            self.layers.append(layer)
+        self.q = torch.empty(
+            len(LAYOUT), TOKENS, HEADS, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE
+        )
+        self.sources = {i: torch.empty_like(self.topk) for _, _, i in LAYOUT if i}
+        self.refresh()
+
+    def refresh(self) -> None:
+        """New queries and new top-k indices from every index source: like the
+        indexer, the first min(512, compressed length) entries of each row are
+        distinct valid indices."""
+        g = self.generator
+        self.q.copy_(torch.randn(self.q.shape, generator=g, device=DEVICE))
+        for source, topk in self.sources.items():
+            ratio = LAYOUT[source][0]
+            topk.fill_(-1)
+            for row in range(TOKENS):
+                valid = SEQ_LENS[row // ROWS] // ratio
+                count = min(TOP_K, valid)
+                picks = torch.randperm(valid, generator=g, device=DEVICE)[:count]
+                topk[row, :count] = picks.to(torch.int32)
+
+    def fresh_plans(self) -> None:
+        """What a metadata build gives each group: empty per-type plans."""
+        for group in self.groups:
+            group.tile_sched_swaonly = sparse_mla.get_mla_metadata()[0]
+            group.tile_sched_c1a = sparse_mla.get_mla_metadata()[0]
+            group.tile_sched_c2a = sparse_mla.get_mla_metadata()[0]
+
+    def forward(self, decode: "sparse_mla.FlashMlaDecode | None") -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Every layer's attention output in model order, on ``decode`` (None:
+        the stock decode); each index source first writes its top-k."""
+        self.fresh_plans()
+        out = torch.zeros_like(self.q)
+        context = ForwardContext(
+            {}, self.by_layer, {}, cudagraph_runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+        )
+        with override_forward_context(context):
+            if decode is not None:
+                decode.tables.reset()
+            for layer_id, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+                if layer_id in self.sources:
+                    self.topk.copy_(self.sources[layer_id])
+                if decode is not None:
+                    decode.run(layer, self.q[layer_id], out[layer_id])
+                    continue
+                kv_source = LAYOUT[layer_id][1]
+                layer._forward_decode(
+                    q=self.q[layer_id],
+                    kv_cache=None
+                    if kv_source is None
+                    else layer._compressed_kv_cache(),
+                    swa_metadata=self.by_layer[layer.swa_cache_layer.prefix],
+                    attn_metadata=(
+                        None if kv_source is None else self.compressed[kv_source][1]
+                    ),
+                    swa_only=kv_source is None,
+                    output=out[layer_id],
+                )
+        return out
+
+
+def _count_plans(monkeypatch, module) -> list:
+    """The plans ``module``'s decode launches pass, in launch order."""
+    plans: list = []
+    launch = module.flash_mla_with_kvcache
+
+    def counted(**kwargs):
+        plans.append(kwargs["tile_scheduler_metadata"])
+        return launch(**kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "flash_mla_with_kvcache", counted)
+    return plans
+

+def _assert_within_one_ulp(actual: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """Each layer's output within one BF16 ulp of its largest magnitude, and
+    within the relative error of one ulp: the kernels sum in another order
+    than FlashMLA, so elements near zero differ by more of their own ulps."""
+    for layer, (a, e) in enumerate(zip(actual.float(), expected.float())):
+        largest = e.abs().max()
+        ulp = torch.exp2(torch.floor(torch.log2(largest)) - 7)
+        error = (a - e).abs().max()
+        assert error <= ulp, (layer, error.item(), ulp.item())
+        assert (a - e).norm() / e.norm() < 2**-8, layer
+

+def _check_rotated_combine(step: Step, decode, out: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """The small path's combine with the inverse RoPE folded in equals its
+    plain combine followed by the stock ``fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant``."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.common.ops.fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant import (
+        fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant,
+    )
+
+    cos_sin = _rope_cache()
+    positions = torch.arange(TOKENS, device=DEVICE) * 37 % 4096
+    context = ForwardContext(
+        {}, step.by_layer, {}, cudagraph_runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+    )
+    with override_forward_context(context):
+        decode.tables.reset()
+        for layer_id, layer in enumerate(step.layers):
+            layer.rotary_emb = SimpleNamespace(cos_sin_cache=cos_sin)
+            layer.n_local_groups = 2
+            if layer_id in step.sources:
+                step.topk.copy_(step.sources[layer_id])
+            rotated = decode.run_rotated(layer, step.q[layer_id], positions)
+            want, _ = fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant(
+                out[layer_id][:, :LOCAL_HEADS],
+                positions,
+                cos_sin,
+                n_groups=2,
+                heads_per_group=LOCAL_HEADS // 2,
+                quantize=False,
+            )
+            assert torch.equal(rotated, want), layer_id
+

+def _rope_cache(positions: int = 4096) -> torch.Tensor:
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(7)
+    angles = torch.rand(positions, 32, generator=g, device=DEVICE) * 6.28
+    return torch.cat([angles.cos(), angles.sin()], -1).contiguous()

+# Per seam: (N, K) per TP4 rank.
+DENSE_SHAPES = {
+    "wqa_wkv": (1792, 5120),
+    "wq_b": (8192, 1280),
+    "index_wq_b": (4096, 1280),
+    "wo_b": (5120, 2048),
+    "shared_gate_up": (1152, 5120),
+    "shared_down": (5120, 576),

+def _mxfp8_weight(n: int, k: int, seed: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A random FP8 weight and UE8M0 scales per 32 k, alike over 32 rows as in
+    the checkpoint."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    w = torch.randn(n, k, generator=g, device=DEVICE).mul(100).clamp(-448, 448)
+    scales = torch.randint(
+        110, 122, (-(-n // 32), k // 32), generator=g, device=DEVICE
+    ).to(torch.uint8)
+    return w.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), scales.repeat_interleave(32, 0)[:n].contiguous()
+
+
+def _dequant(w: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    scale = torch.exp2(scales.float() - 127)
+    return (w.float().unflatten(-1, (-1, 32)) * scale.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def _humming_linear(
+    w: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor, parts: list[int] | None = None
+):
+    """``w`` (output ``parts``) as the stock SM90 Humming W8A16 linear holds
+    it: the weight and scales and the Humming kernel's config and locks."""
+    from torch import nn
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming import (
+        convert_linear_layer_to_humming_standard,
+        get_humming_linear_compute_config,
+        prepare_humming_linear_layer_config,
+        quant_key_to_input_schema,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kMxfp8Dynamic,
+    )
+    from vllm.utils.humming import create_humming_locks
+
+    n, k = w.shape
+    layer = nn.Module()
+    layer.input_size_per_partition = layer.input_size = k
+    layer.output_partition_sizes = parts or [n]
+    layer.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    layer.has_bias = False
+    layer.weight = nn.Parameter(w.clone(), requires_grad=False)
+    layer.weight_scale = nn.Parameter(
+        scales.clone().view(torch.float8_e8m0fnu), requires_grad=False
+    )
+    convert_linear_layer_to_humming_standard(
+        layer=layer, name_map={"weight": "weight", "weight_scale": "weight_scale"}
+    )
+    config = prepare_humming_linear_layer_config(
+        layer,
+        {
+            "quant_method": "humming",
+            "dtype": "float8e4m3",
+            "scale_dtype": "float8e8m0",
+            "group_size": 32,
+            "weight_scale_type": "group",
+        },
+        input_schema=quant_key_to_input_schema(kMxfp8Dynamic),
+    )
+    return layer, SimpleNamespace(
+        layer_config=config,
+        compute_config=get_humming_linear_compute_config(),
+        locks=create_humming_locks(DEVICE),
+    )
+
+
+def _rel(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    return ((a.float() - b.float()).norm() / b.float().norm()).item()
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("seam", list(DENSE_SHAPES))
+def test_dense_calls_match_the_stock_linear(seam):
+    """Every row count a seam serves: its call (CuTe DSL or tuned Humming, as
+    dispatched) against an FP32 product of the exact dequantized weight, and
+    against the stock Humming linear; strided rows as the executor passes
+    them; the CuTe calls are deterministic."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming import (
+        apply_humming_linear,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.hopper import dense
+
+    n, k = DENSE_SHAPES[seam]
+    w, scales = _mxfp8_weight(n, k, seed=n + k)
+    layer, humming = _humming_linear(w, scales)
+    linear = dense.DenseFp8Linear(seam, layer.weight, layer.weight_scale, n, k, humming)
+    reference_weight = _dequant(w, scales)
+    served = [m for m in range(1, dense.MAX_ROWS + 1) if linear.serves(m)]
+    assert served == list(range(1, max(dense.DISPATCH[seam]) + 1))
+    assert not linear.serves(max(dense.DISPATCH[seam]) + 1)
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(0)
+    for m in served:
+        x = torch.randn(m, k + 64, generator=g, device=DEVICE).bfloat16()[:, :k]
+        want = x.float() @ reference_weight.t()
+        got = linear(x)
+        stock = apply_humming_linear(
+            layer,
+            x,
+            skip_bias_add=True,
+            layer_config=humming.layer_config,
+            compute_config=humming.compute_config,
+            locks=humming.locks,
+        )
+        assert _rel(got, want) < 5e-3, (m, _rel(got, want))
+        assert _rel(got, stock) < 8e-3, (m, _rel(got, stock))
+        if linear.publishes(m):
+            assert torch.equal(linear(x), got), m

+def test_fp8_wo_a_matches_the_stock_bmm():
+    """The FP8 copy of the stock BF16 ``wo_a`` (dequantized at load) is exact,
+    and its grouped call on the inverse RoPE's group-major output matches the
+    stock BF16 bmm at every row count; a weight that is not an MXFP8 dequant
+    keeps the bmm."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.hopper import dense
+
+    groups, rank, k = 2, 1024, 4096
+    w, scales = _mxfp8_weight(groups * rank, k, seed=1)
+    bf16 = _dequant(w, scales).bfloat16()
+    linear = dense.fp8_wo_a(SimpleNamespace(weight=bf16), groups)
+    assert linear is not None
+    not_mxfp8 = SimpleNamespace(weight=bf16 + 2.0**-7 * bf16.abs().max())
+    assert dense.fp8_wo_a(not_mxfp8, groups) is None
+    grouped = bf16.view(groups, rank, k)
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(0)
+    served = max(dense.DISPATCH["wo_a"])
+    assert not linear.serves(served + 1)
+    for m in range(1, served + 1):
+        assert linear.serves(m)
+        # The inverse RoPE writes [groups, tokens, k] and returns its transpose.
+        rotated = torch.randn(groups, m, k, generator=g, device=DEVICE).bfloat16()
+        x = rotated.transpose(0, 1)
+        want = torch.einsum("tgk,gnk->tgn", x.float(), grouped.float()).flatten(1)
+        stock = torch.bmm(rotated, grouped.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(0, 1)
+        got = linear(x)
+        assert _rel(got, want) < 5e-3, (m, _rel(got, want))
+        assert _rel(got, stock.flatten(1)) < 8e-3, m
+

+MOE_HIDDEN, MOE_INTER = 5120, 576
+# (experts, top-k): the backbone's layers and the DSpark drafter's.
+MOE_SHAPES = ((384, 6), (128, 3))
+FP4_VALUES = (0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0)

+def _mxfp4_dequant(w: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    lut = torch.tensor(FP4_VALUES + tuple(-v for v in FP4_VALUES), device=DEVICE)
+    values = torch.stack([lut[(w & 0xF).long()], lut[(w >> 4).long()]], -1)
+    scale = torch.exp2(scales.float() - 127).unsqueeze(-1)
+    return (values.flatten(-2).unflatten(-1, (-1, 32)) * scale).flatten(-2)

+def _stock_moe(num_experts: int, top_k: int):
+    """A stock Humming W4A8 MoE layer (MXFP4 experts, block-FP8 activations)
+    of one TP4 rank's shapes, on random checkpoint-format weights."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import FusedMoEFactory
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle import mxfp4 as oracle
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.mxfp4 import (
+        Mxfp4Config,
+        Mxfp4MoEMethod,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kMxfp8Dynamic,
+    )
+
+    class Config(Mxfp4Config):
+        def _make_moe_method(self, moe):
+            return Mxfp4MoEMethod(moe, activation_key=kMxfp8Dynamic)
+
+    oracle._user_moe_activation_override = lambda: None
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(0)
+
+    def randint(low, high, *shape):

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The specialized decode executor on Hopper (SM90): the executor's schedule
+(fused all-reduce + mHC boundaries, side streams, tables shared across layers,
+recorded metadata builds) over the Hopper stock kernels, with one function per

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The early-trigger small kernels of the Hopper attention chain
+(``attn_cute``), for steps on the small-batch sparse MLA up to ``MAX_ROWS``
+rows.
+
+They replace, with bitwise-equal results:
+
+- ``fused_q_kv_rmsnorm`` and the KV half of
+  ``fused_deepseek_v4_qnorm_rope_kv_rope_quant_insert`` by one kernel on the
+  ``fused_wqa_wkv`` output (``norm_kv_insert``);
+- the Q half of that op by ``q_rope`` (RoPE of the 16 live heads; the small MLA
+  reads only those, so the padding heads are left unwritten);
+- the MLA ``Combine`` and ``fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant`` by one kernel writing
+  the ``wo_a`` input (``mla_small``).
+
+Each triggers its dependents at block start and waits for its predecessor only
+before the first activation read, so the next kernel (a GEMM that loads its
+weights before its own wait) becomes resident and loads during it.
+"""
+
+from functools import cache
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import torch
+
+from ...flashmla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_swa import DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata
+
+MAX_ROWS = 8
+_Q_LORA, _KV, _HEADS, _HEAD_DIM, _ROPE = 1280, 512, 16, 512, 64
+
+
+def applies(attn: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention) -> bool:
+    """Whether the layer's shapes and cache format are the kernels': a TP4
+    shard on the V4 ``fp8_ds_mla`` SWA record with an FP32 GPT-J cache."""
+    cos_sin = attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache
+    return (
+        attn.q_lora_rank == _Q_LORA
+        and attn.head_dim == _HEAD_DIM
+        and attn.n_local_heads == _HEADS
+        and attn.padded_heads == 64
+        and attn.n_local_groups == 2
+        and not attn.kv_mxfp8
+        and not attn.use_pcp
+        and not attn.accepts_unnormed_unroped_query
+        and cos_sin.dtype == torch.float32
+        and cos_sin.shape[-1] == _ROPE
+    )
+
+
+@cache
+def compiled(kind: str, flag: Any):
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+    from . import attn_cute
+
+    i, p = Int32(1), Int64(0)
+    if kind == "norm":
+        kernel: Any = attn_cute.QkvNorm(flag)
+        args = [p, i, p, i, p, p, p, p, p, i, p, p, p, i]
+    elif kind == "qrope":
+        kernel = attn_cute.QRope()
+        args = [p, i, p, p, p, i]
+    else:
+        kernel = attn_cute.CombineInvRope(_HEADS, flag)
+        args = [p, p, p, p, i, i, p, p, i, i, i]
+    return cute.compile(kernel, *args, make_fake_stream())
+
+
+def launch(kind: str, flag: Any, *args: Any) -> None:
+    """``kind``'s kernel on the current stream; tensors pass their address,
+    ``("i64", n)`` a 64-bit value, other ints Int32."""
+    from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+
+    from vllm.models.common.ops.moe_tail_fusion.primitives import current_cu_stream
+
+    values: list = []
+    for arg in args:
+        if isinstance(arg, torch.Tensor):
+            values.append(Int64(arg.data_ptr()))
+        elif isinstance(arg, tuple):
+            values.append(Int64(arg[1]))
+        else:
+            values.append(Int32(arg))
+    compiled(kind, flag)(*values, current_cu_stream())
+
+
+def norm_kv_insert(
+    attn: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention,
+    qr_kv: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    swa_metadata: "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata",
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The normalized query ``qr`` [rows, 1280] of the ``fused_wqa_wkv``
+    output; the step's KV (normalized, rotated, quantized) is inserted into
+    the SWA cache."""
+    rows = qr_kv.shape[0]
+    assert qr_kv.shape[1] == _Q_LORA + _KV and qr_kv.stride(1) == 1
+    assert positions.dtype == torch.int64
+    slots = swa_metadata.slot_mapping
+    assert slots.dtype == torch.int64
+    cache = attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache
+    cache_2d = cache.view(cache.shape[0], -1)
+    qr = torch.empty(rows, _Q_LORA, dtype=qr_kv.dtype, device=qr_kv.device)
+    launch(
+        "norm",
+        float(attn.eps),
+        qr_kv,
+        qr_kv.stride(0),
+        qr,
+        qr.stride(0),
+        ("i64", 0),
+        attn.q_norm.weight,
+        attn.kv_norm.weight,
+        cache_2d,
+        ("i64", cache_2d.stride(0)),
+        swa_metadata.block_size,
+        slots,
+        positions,
+        attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+        rows,
+    )
+    return qr
+
+
+def q_rope(
+    attn: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention, q: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``q`` [rows, 16, 512] with RoPE on its last 64 dims, in a [rows, 64,
+    512] buffer whose padding heads are left unwritten (the small MLA reads
+    heads 0..15 only)."""
+    rows = q.shape[0]
+    assert q.shape[1:] == (_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM) and q.stride(1) == _HEAD_DIM
+    out = torch.empty(rows, 64, _HEAD_DIM, dtype=q.dtype, device=q.device)
+    launch(
+        "qrope",
+        None,
+        q,
+        q.stride(0),
+        out,
+        positions,
+        attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+        rows,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def warm_up(eps: float) -> None:
+    """Compile the kernels before CUDA graph capture."""
+    compiled("norm", eps)
+    compiled("qrope", None)
+    for slots in (8, 40):
+        compiled("combine", slots)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""PDL-early-trigger CuTe DSL replacements for the small kernels of the DSV4.1 SM90
+attention chain (TP4: q_lora 1280, head_dim 512 = 448 NoPE + 64 RoPE, 16 local heads,
+2 wo_a groups of 8 heads, V4 584 B fp8_ds_mla SWA record).
+
+Every kernel calls griddepcontrol.launch_dependents at block start, loads only static
+data (norm weights) before griddepcontrol.wait, reads activations after it with L2
+(.cg) loads, and uses no or tiny smem, so the next kernel (a weight-preloading GEMV)
+can become resident and stage its weights while this one runs.
+
+  QkvNorm       fused_q_kv_rmsnorm + the KV half of
+                fused_deepseek_v4_qnorm_rope_kv_rope_quant_insert (GPT-J RoPE on dims
+                448..511, UE8M0 FP8 quant, V4 record insert) straight from the
+                fused_wqa_wkv output [M, 1792].
+  QRope         the Q half of that op: GPT-J RoPE of the 16 live heads, copied
+                into the padded [M, 64, 512] query buffer.
+  CombineInvRope  ``mla_cute.Combine`` with fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant(quantize=False)
+                folded in: merges the split partials with the sink, inverse GPT-J
+                RoPE, writes the wo_a input [T, 2, 4096] (any token / group stride).
+
+Host calls: ``attn_chain``.
+"""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64
+from cutlass.cute.arch import inline_ptx
+
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+BM, DV = 64, 512
+NOPE = 448
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ PTX helpers
+def ldg4_cg(addr: Int64):
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "ld.global.cg.v4.b32 {{$w0}, {$w1}, {$w2}, {$w3}}, [{$r0}];",
+        write_only_types=[Int32] * 4,
+        read_only_args=[addr],
+    )
+
+
+def ldg4_nc(addr: Int64):
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "ld.global.nc.v4.b32 {{$w0}, {$w1}, {$w2}, {$w3}}, [{$r0}];",
+        write_only_types=[Int32] * 4,
+        read_only_args=[addr],
+    )
+
+
+def ldg2_cg(addr: Int64):
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "ld.global.cg.v2.b32 {{$w0}, {$w1}}, [{$r0}];",
+        write_only_types=[Int32] * 2,
+        read_only_args=[addr],
+    )
+
+
+def ldf4_nc(addr: Int64):
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "ld.global.nc.v4.f32 {{$w0}, {$w1}, {$w2}, {$w3}}, [{$r0}];",
+        write_only_types=[Float32] * 4,
+        read_only_args=[addr],
+    )
+
+
+def ldf_nc(addr: Int64) -> Float32:
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "ld.global.nc.f32 {$w0}, [{$r0}];",
+        write_only_types=[Float32],
+        read_only_args=[addr],
+    )
+
+
+def ldi64_cg(addr: Int64) -> Int64:
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "ld.global.cg.b64 {$w0}, [{$r0}];",
+        write_only_types=[Int64],
+        read_only_args=[addr],
+    )
+
+
+def stg4(addr: Int64, a, b, c, d):
+    inline_ptx(
+        "st.global.v4.b32 [{$r0}], {{$r1}, {$r2}, {$r3}, {$r4}};",
+        read_only_args=[addr, a, b, c, d],
+    )
+
+
+def stg2(addr: Int64, a, b):
+    inline_ptx("st.global.v2.b32 [{$r0}], {{$r1}, {$r2}};", read_only_args=[addr, a, b])
+
+
+def stg_u8(addr: Int64, v: Int32):
+    inline_ptx(
+        "{ .reg .b16 h; cvt.u16.u32 h, {$r1}; st.global.b8 [{$r0}], h; }",
+        read_only_args=[addr, v],
+    )
+
+
+def bf2(w: Int32):
+    """bf16x2 word -> (lo, hi) fp32."""
+    return bitsf(w << 16), bitsf(w & Int32(-65536))
+
+
+def pk(lo, hi) -> Int32:
+    """(lo, hi) fp32 -> bf16x2 (RN)."""
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32 {$w0}, {$r1}, {$r0};",
+        write_only_types=[Int32],
+        read_only_args=[lo, hi],
+    )
+
+
+def rnd(x) -> Float32:
+    """Round fp32 to bf16 and back."""
+    return bitsf(
+        inline_ptx(
+            "{ .reg .b16 h, z; mov.b16 z, 0; cvt.rn.bf16.f32 h, {$r0};"
+            " mov.b32 {$w0}, {z, h}; }",
+            write_only_types=[Int32],
+            read_only_args=[x],
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def rsqrt_approx(x) -> Float32:
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "rsqrt.approx.f32 {$w0}, {$r0};", write_only_types=[Float32], read_only_args=[x]
+    )
+
+
+def div_rn(a, b) -> Float32:
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "div.rn.f32 {$w0}, {$r0}, {$r1};",
+        write_only_types=[Float32],
+        read_only_args=[a, b],
+    )
+
+
+def fbits(x) -> Int32:
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "mov.b32 {$w0}, {$r0};", write_only_types=[Int32], read_only_args=[x]
+    )
+
+
+def bitsf(x) -> Float32:
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "mov.b32 {$w0}, {$r0};", write_only_types=[Float32], read_only_args=[x]
+    )
+
+
+def e4m3x4(a, b, c, d) -> Int32:
+    """4 fp32 -> 4 e4m3 bytes (a at the lowest address), RN satfinite."""
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "{ .reg .b16 l, h; cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 l, {$r1}, {$r0};"
+        " cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 h, {$r3}, {$r2}; mov.b32 {$w0}, {l, h}; }",
+        write_only_types=[Int32],
+        read_only_args=[a, b, c, d],
+    )
+
+
+def warp_sum(v):
+    for o in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1):
+        v = v + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(v, offset=o)
+    return v
+
+
+def fmaxf(a, b):
+    return cutlass.max(a, b)
+
+
+def fminf(a, b):
+    return cutlass.min(a, b)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- QkvNorm (K1)
+class QkvNorm:
+    """grid = M CTAs x 64 threads. Warp 0: qr = RMSNorm(qkv[:, :1280]) * wq -> bf16.
+    Warp 1: kv = RMSNorm(qkv[:, 1280:]) * wkv rounded to bf16; then the stock V4 KV
+    insert (GPT-J RoPE on 448..511, 64-dim UE8M0 FP8 blocks, bf16 RoPE). Lane L of
+    warp 1 owns dims [16L, 16L+16) (stock map). ``kvo`` is unused."""
+
+    def __init__(self, eps: float = 1e-6):
+        self.eps = eps
+
+    @cute.jit

+  coefficients on the mHC side stream, up to the stock decode's cap
+  (``mhc_overlap_max_tokens()``, 144 rows); the residual-only boundaries too.

+  post and pre (``HopperBoundaries``).

+  sparse MLA shares one FlashMLA plan per layer type and one global top-k
+  table per index source (``sparse_mla``), or up to ``mla_small.MAX_ROWS``

+A stock SM90 FP8 linear is Humming W8A16: BF16 activations times FP8 weights

+``MAX_ROWS`` rows, on the kernel ``DISPATCH`` picks for its seam and row count,
+reading the linear's Humming weight and scales in place:
+
+- the CuTe DSL kernel (``dense_gemm_cute``) with a geometry (``Cute``), which
+  can also publish its output into the fused all-reduce + mHC mailbox;
+- Humming with a tuned tiling (``use_pdl`` set), or with its own heuristic
+  tiling (``HEURISTIC``) and ``use_pdl`` set.
+
+The choices up to 48 rows were measured in a PDL decode-layer chain on H200 at
+TP4, the 96-, 144- and 192-row Humming tilings in isolation; a row count between two
+entries takes the larger entry's choice. The CuTe kernel stages its rows of X
+in shared memory, which bounds it to 48 rows. Every kernel here
+uses programmatic dependent launch. CuTe kernels compile, and Humming kernels
+JIT-compile, on first use: the executor warms both up before CUDA graph
+capture (``warm_up``).

+``wo_a`` is the exception to reading in place: the stock SM90 layer keeps it
+only as BF16, dequantized at load. ``fp8_wo_a`` rebuilds the exact FP8 weight

+def choice(seam: str, rows: int) -> Cute | dict | None:
+    """The kernel of ``seam`` for ``rows`` rows, or None above its table."""
+    table = DISPATCH[seam]
+    above = [m for m in table if m >= rows]
+    return table[min(above)] if rows > 0 and above else None

+def _staged_rows(k: int, sk: int) -> int:
+    return ((k // 16 + sk - 1) // sk + 3) // 2 * 2

+def cute_fits(c: Cute, rows: int, n: int, k: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether geometry ``c`` launches ``rows`` x ``n`` x ``k`` (tiling,
+    registers, at least two 16-k rows per split and shared memory)."""
+    nt = (rows + 7) // 8
+    if (4 * c.tw) % c.wm or c.S % (2 * c.kg) or n % (64 * c.tw * c.cn):
+        return False
+    if c.sk * c.cn > 8:
+        return False
+    if c.wm * nt * 4 > 96 or (k // 16) // c.sk < 2:

+            dtype, (cute.sym_int(),), stride=(1,), assumed_align=16
+        )

+    kernel = DenseFp8Gemm(

+"""Small-M dense FP8 GEMM on the Humming W8A16 layout, in CuTe DSL (SM90).
+
+``Y[M, N] = X[M, K] @ dequant(W)^T`` for at most 48 BF16 rows of ``X``, reading
+the weight and scales of a stock SM90 Humming W8A16 linear in place:
+
+- ``weight`` int32 ``[Kp / 16, Np * 4]``: one 1 KiB block per (16 k, 64 n),
+  laid out as ``mma.sync`` A fragments (lane ``(n % 8) * 4 + (k % 8) // 2``,
+  word ``(n % 64) // 8``, byte ``[0, 2, 1, 3][((k % 16) // 8) * 2 + k % 2]``);
+- ``weight_scale`` UE8M0 ``[Kp / 32, Np]``, the 8 x 8 (n % 8, n // 8) index of
+  each 64-column block transposed.
+
+Swap-AB: the weight is operand A (64 output columns per tile, ``tw`` tiles per
+CTA) and the tokens operand B, ``m16n8k16`` MMAs with FP32 accumulation. Two
+operand precisions:
+
+- ``prec`` 0 (f16): weights convert exactly with ``cvt.rn.f16x2.e4m3x2``; each
+  32-k group's partial is scaled by its UE8M0 scale in FP32. X is staged once
+  per CTA and converted to f16 with a per-token power-of-two pre-scale chosen
+  from its absolute maximum over the slice, undone exactly on the FP32 sums.
+- ``prec`` 1 (bf16): weights are dequantized by bit surgery and multiplied by
+  the scale in BF16 (exact for an e4m3 value times a power of two).
+
+Pipeline: two DMA warps stream ``S``-row (16 k each) W/S stages through ``NS``
+shared-memory buffers with ``cp.async`` and mbarriers, the weights with an
+evict-first L2 policy (each is read once a step); they start before the
+programmatic grid wait (the weights do not depend on the previous kernel).
+The consumer warps (``4 * tw / wm`` column groups x ``kg`` k groups) wait, load
+X with bulk copies, then consume the stages; the k groups reduce through shared
+memory in a fixed order. K is split ``sk`` ways over a ``(sk, 1, 1)`` cluster,
+whose partials rank 0 sums through distributed shared memory in a fixed order,
+so the result is deterministic. Grouped mode (``wo_a``): output columns
+``[g * n_group, (g + 1) * n_group)`` read ``X[:, g * x_gstride : ...]``.
+
+Publishing (``pub``): the epilogue also stores the BF16 output, negative zero
+cleared, into this rank's slot of generation ``stage_state[0]`` of a fused
+all-reduce + mHC Lamport mailbox on every rank (``multimem.st``), and one
+thread sets ``stage_state[1]`` to that generation: the work of the all-reduce's
+publish kernel (``_SharedOnlyPublishDeviceKernel``). It reads ``stage_state[0]``
+after its grid wait, which the previous consumer wrote; the consumer, the next
+kernel, reads ``stage_state[1]`` after its own grid wait, after this grid.
+
+Every launch uses programmatic dependent launch and triggers its dependents
+right after its prologue.

+            pol = evict_first_policy()
+            for c in cutlass.range(nch):
+                stage = c % NS
+                r = rb + c * S
+                rows = re - r
+                if rows > S:
+                    rows = Int32(S)
+                if c >= NS:
+                    phase = ((c // NS) - 1) % 2
+                    eb = s_empty + 8 * stage
+                    done = mbar_try_wait(eb, phase)
+                    while done == 0:
+                        done = mbar_try_wait(eb, phase)
+                self.issue_stage(
+                    dt,
+                    s_stage0 + stage * self.stage_bytes,
+                    t,
+                    r,
+                    rows,
+                    wg,
+                    sg,
+                    Np,
+                    pol,
+                )
+                cp_async_arrive_noinc(s_full + 8 * stage)
+            if const_expr(sk > 1):
+                cluster_wait_acquire()
+                cluster_arrive_release()
+                cluster_wait_acquire()
+        else:
+            ctid = tidx
+            nct = self.cw * 32
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            if const_expr(cn > 1):
+                cluster_wait_acquire()  # the peers' X barriers are armed
+            # Stage X[:, rb * 16 : re * 16] once, one bulk copy per token; with
+            # cn > 1, each CTA multicasts 1/cn of the tokens to its K slice's.
+            nrow = re - rb
+            cpt = nrow * 2
+            xsrc = xg + Int64((((t * tw * 64) // n_group) * x_gstride) * 2 + rb * 32)
+            if warp == 0:
+                if lane == 0:
+                    mbar_arrive_expect_tx(s_xbar, M * nrow * 32)

+                if const_expr(cn > 1):
+                    mask = 0
+                    for c_ in range(cn):
+                        mask |= 1 << (sk * c_)

+                            st,

+                            lane,

+                            lm_tok,

+        "add.u32 t, {$r0}, 0x7878;\n"
+        "prmt.b32 u, t, z, 0x4040;\n"
+        "shl.b32 {$w0}, u, 7;\n"
+        "prmt.b32 u, t, z, 0x4141;\n"

+    return inline_ptx(
+        "{ .reg .b32 t0, t1, t2, z; mov.b32 z, 0;\n"
+        "prmt.b32 t0, {$r0}, z, 0x2404;\n"
+        "shr.u32 t1, t0, 4;\n"
+        "and.b32 t1, t1, 0x07F007F0;\n"
+        "and.b32 t0, t0, 0x80008000;\n"
+        "or.b32 t0, t0, t1;\n"
+        "shr.u32 t1, {$r0}, 4;\n"
+        "and.b32 t1, t1, 0x07F007F0;\n"
+        "and.b32 t2, {$r0}, 0x80008000;\n"
+        "or.b32 t2, t2, t1;\n"
+        "mul.rn.bf16x2 {$w0}, t0, {$r1};\n"
+        "mul.rn.bf16x2 {$w1}, t2, {$r1}; }",
+        write_only_types=[Int32, Int32],

+
+
+def mapa(addr: Int32, rank: Int32) -> Int32:

+        "mapa.shared::cluster.u32 {$w0}, {$r0}, {$r1};",
+        write_only_types=[Int32],

+
+def st_dsmem_f32x4(addr: Int32, a, b, c, d):

+
+def cluster_arrive_release():

+
+
+def cluster_wait_acquire():

+
+def pack_bf16x2(a, b) -> Int32:
+    return inline_ptx(
+        "cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32 {$w0}, {$r1}, {$r0};",

+
+
+def stg_b32x2(addr: Int64, a, b):
+    inline_ptx("st.global.v2.b32 [{$r0}], {{$r1}, {$r2}};", read_only_args=[addr, a, b])

+
+def ld_volatile_u32(addr: Int64) -> Int32:

+        write_only_types=[Int32],
+        read_only_args=[addr],
+    )
+
+
+def st_global_u32(addr: Int64, v: Int32):
+    inline_ptx("st.global.u32 [{$r0}], {$r1};", read_only_args=[addr, v])
+
+
+def stmc_b32x2(addr: Int64, a, b):
+    """``multimem.st`` of 4 BF16 values into every rank's mailbox copy."""
+    inline_ptx(
+        "multimem.st.relaxed.sys.global.v2.bf16x2 [{$r0}], {{$r1}, {$r2}};",
+        read_only_args=[addr, a, b],

+
+def clear_negzero_bf16x2(w: Int32) -> Int32:
+    """BF16x2 with negative-zero halves (the Lamport sentinel) made +0."""
+    return inline_ptx(

+        "mov.b32 r, {$r0};\n"
+        "and.b32 t, r, 0xFFFF; setp.eq.u32 p, t, 0x8000; "

+        "shr.u32 t, r, 16; setp.eq.u32 p, t, 0x8000; "
+        "@p and.b32 r, r, 0x0000FFFF;\n"
+        "mov.b32 {$w0}, r; }",
+        write_only_types=[Int32],
+        read_only_args=[w],
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The DSpark draft model's specialized decode on Hopper.
+
+``HopperDraftDecode`` is ``DraftDecode`` (the same layer loop, first-layer mHC
+pre of the expanded embedding, residual-only last boundary and collapse) over
+the draft's sliding-window layers with the Hopper kernel choices, on the
+target executor's fused all-reduce + mHC kernel, mailbox and mHC side stream:
+
+- attention: ``HopperAttentionStep`` (the dense FP8 projections, ``wo_b``
+  publishing where its kernel can) on the draft's own FlashMLA tables, so the
+  small-batch kernels take steps whose SWA window they hold;
+- MoE (128 experts, top-3): the low-batch MoE kernel up to ``moe.MAX_ROWS``
+  rows, finalized in the layer (the fused kernel's finalize is built for the
+  target's top-k) with the routed-expert finalize kernel; above that the
+  runner's body, TP-partial;
+- ``main_proj``, which prepares the draft's context, on tuned Humming calls.
+
+The draft's stock layers reduce ``wo_b`` and the MoE themselves; every call
+here leaves them TP-partial for the next boundary.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.forward_context import is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+    MoEOutput,
+    UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.runner.moe_runner import _unpack
+
+from ...flashmla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
+from ..runtime.decode import DecodeStep, captures_pure_decode
+from ..runtime.draft import DraftDecode, DraftLayerPlan
+from . import kernels
+from .dense import DenseFp8Linear
+from .sparse_mla import FlashMlaDecode, FlashMlaTables
+from .steps import HopperAttentionStep, HopperMoEStep
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from ...dspark import DSparkDeepseekV4Model
+    from ...model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer, DeepseekV4MoE
+    from .decode import HopperSpecializedDecode
+
+
+class HopperDraftMoEStep(HopperMoEStep):
+    """A draft MoE layer, finalized in the layer."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ffn: "DeepseekV4MoE", max_rows: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__(ffn, max_rows)
+        if self.runner.routed_scaling_factor != 1.0:
+            # The runner's body adds the shared and routed outputs without the
+            # stock forward's routed scaling.
+            raise ValueError(
+                "decode_backend=latency_specialized requires the draft's MoE to "
+                "have routed_scaling_factor == 1.0"
+            )
+        self.deferrable = False
+
+    def run(
+        self, x: torch.Tensor, input_ids: torch.Tensor | None, step: DecodeStep
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        rows = x.shape[0]
+        routed = self.routed
+        if routed is not None and routed.serves(rows):
+            out = kernels.moe(self.ffn, self.shared, routed, x, input_ids)
+            assert isinstance(out, MoEOutput)
+            assert isinstance(out.routed, UnfinalizedMoEOutput)
+            assert out.shared_output is not None
+            return out.shared_output + finalize(out.routed)
+        with kernels.shared_installed(self.shared, rows):
+            shared_output, finalized = _unpack(
+                self.runner._forward_impl(x, x, x, input_ids)
+            )
+        assert shared_output is not None and isinstance(finalized, torch.Tensor)
+        return shared_output + finalized
+
+
+def finalize(routed: UnfinalizedMoEOutput) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The top-k reduction of the low-batch MoE kernel's rows: BF16 [rows,
+    5120] (``routed_expert_finalize_cute``)."""
+    import cutlass
+    from cutlass import Int32
+
+    from vllm.models.common.ops.moe_tail_fusion.primitives import current_cu_stream
+
+    from ..moe.routed_expert_gemm import _finalize_kernel, _pointer
+
+    rows, top_k = routed.expert_weights.shape
+    device = routed.gemm2_permuted.device
+    output = torch.empty(
+        (rows, routed.gemm2_permuted.shape[-1]), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+    )
+    _finalize_kernel(device.index)(
+        _pointer(cutlass.BFloat16, routed.gemm2_permuted, 16),
+        _pointer(cutlass.Int32, routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx, 4),
+        _pointer(cutlass.Float32, routed.expert_weights, 4),
+        _pointer(cutlass.BFloat16, output, 16),
+        Int32(rows),
+        Int32(top_k),
+        current_cu_stream(),
+    )
+    return output
+
+
+class HopperDraftDecode(DraftDecode):
+    """The decode executor over the DSpark draft model's layers on Hopper."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, target: "HopperSpecializedDecode", backbone: "DSparkDeepseekV4Model"
+    ) -> None:
+        if backbone.use_sequence_parallel or backbone.use_native_mega_moe:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "decode_backend=latency_specialized runs the DSpark draft without "
+                "sequence parallelism or the native mega MoE"
+            )
+        self.backbone = backbone
+        self.target = target
+        layers = [cast("DeepseekV4DecoderLayer", layer) for layer in backbone.layers]
+        attns: list[DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention] = []
+        for layer in layers:
+            if type(layer.attn) is not DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "decode_backend=latency_specialized on Hopper needs the "
+                    f"FlashMLA sparse attention, not {type(layer.attn).__name__}"
+                )
+            attns.append(layer.attn)
+        self.max_rows = target.max_rows
+        self.mhc_stream = target.mhc_stream
+        self.all_reduce = target.all_reduce
+        self.boundaries = target.boundaries
+        self.tables = tables = FlashMlaTables(attns)
+        self.small_mla = tables.small
+        self.mla = mla = FlashMlaDecode(tables)
+        self.plans = [
+            DraftLayerPlan(
+                layer=layer,
+                attention=HopperAttentionStep(attn, tables, mla, self.all_reduce),
+                moe=HopperDraftMoEStep(layer.ffn, self.max_rows),
+            )
+            for layer, attn in zip(layers, attns)
+        ]
+        self._swa_prefixes = sorted({attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix for attn in attns})
+        self.main_proj = DenseFp8Linear.of("main_proj", backbone.main_proj)
+        if self.main_proj is not None:
+            install_main_proj(backbone.main_proj, self.main_proj)
+
+    def plan(self, positions: torch.Tensor) -> DecodeStep | None:
+        """As the target's: only FULL CUDA graph captures of pure decode steps
+        of up to ``max_rows`` rows run the executor."""
+        rows = positions.shape[0]
+        if (
+            not 0 < rows <= self.max_rows
+            or not is_forward_context_available()
+            or not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+            or not captures_pure_decode(self._swa_prefixes)
+        ):
+            return None
+        return self.target.gates(rows)._replace(executor=self)
+
+
+def install_main_proj(main_proj: torch.nn.Module, linear: DenseFp8Linear) -> None:
+    """Run ``main_proj``'s forward on ``linear`` for the rows it serves."""
+    stock = main_proj.forward
+    return_bias = getattr(main_proj, "return_bias", True)
+
+    def forward(x: torch.Tensor):
+        if x.dim() != 2 or not linear.serves(x.shape[0]):
+            return stock(x)
+        out = linear(x.contiguous())
+        return (out, None) if return_bias else out
+
+    main_proj.forward = forward

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The fused FP8 decode indexer of the Hopper executor, for uniform decode
+steps of up to ``MAX_ROWS`` rows.
+
+It replaces the stock decode branch of ``sparse_attn_indexer`` (DeepGEMM
+paged MQA logits, the candidate select or mask, the top-k and the ``-1``
+fill) on the stock indexer K cache:
+
+- ``IdxLogits`` (``indexer_cute_logits``): FP8 WGMMA logits of all verify rows
+  of a request per index-K tile, masked to the step's candidate bitmap on a
+  candidate consumer, ``-inf`` past each row's length;
+- on the candidate source, ``IdxSelect2`` (``indexer_cute_select``) writes the
+  candidate blocks (the stock list, for steps on the stock path) and the
+  bitmap the consumers read;
+- the stock ``cooperative_topk`` selects the top-k, writing the whole ``-1``
+  padded row.
+
+The candidate bitmap is per step: the source writes it before its consumers
+read it, in the same graph.
+"""
+
+from functools import cache
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import SparseAttnIndexer
+
+MAX_ROWS = 48
+_TOP_K, _HEADS, _HEAD_DIM, _CANDIDATE_BLOCK = 512, 32, 128, 8
+_TILE = 64
+
+
+@cache
+def _compiled(kind: str, *flags: Any):
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+    i, p = Int32(1), Int64(0)
+    if kind == "logits":
+        from .indexer_cute_logits import IdxLogits
+
+        rows_per_request, tiles_per_cta, masked = flags
+        kernel: Any = IdxLogits(rows_per_request, tiles_per_cta, 3, masked)
+        args = [p, p, p, p, i, p, i, p, p, i, p, i, i, i]
+    else:
+        from .indexer_cute_select import IdxSelect2
+
+        cand_k, width = flags
+        kernel = IdxSelect2(cand_k, width)
+        args = [p, i, p, p, i, p, i, i]
+    return cute.compile(kernel, *args, make_fake_stream())
+
+
+def _launch(kind: str, flags: tuple, *args: Any) -> None:
+    from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+
+    from vllm.models.common.ops.moe_tail_fusion.primitives import current_cu_stream
+
+    values: list = []
+    for arg in args:
+        if isinstance(arg, torch.Tensor):
+            values.append(Int64(arg.data_ptr()))
+        elif isinstance(arg, tuple):
+            values.append(Int64(arg[1]))
+        else:
+            values.append(Int32(arg))
+    _compiled(kind, *flags)(*values, current_cu_stream())
+
+
+def applies(op: SparseAttnIndexer) -> bool:
+    """Whether the kernels take the indexer: an FP8 K cache, no context
+    parallelism, the 512-wide top-k and 8-position candidate blocks."""
+    if not isinstance(op, SparseAttnIndexer):
+        return False
+    candidates = getattr(op, "candidate_blocks", None)
+    return (
+        not op.use_fp4_cache
+        and op.dcp_world_size == 1
+        and not op.use_pcp
+        and op.topk_tokens == _TOP_K
+        and op.head_dim == _HEAD_DIM
+        and (candidates is None or op.candidate_block_size == _CANDIDATE_BLOCK)
+    )
+
+
+class FusedDecodeIndexer:
+    """The buffers of the fused indexer, shared by every layer of a step."""
+
+    def __init__(self, max_model_len: int, device: torch.device) -> None:
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.indexer_topk import RADIX_TOPK_WORKSPACE_SIZE
+
+        self.width = -(-max_model_len // _TILE) * _TILE
+        self.logits = torch.empty(
+            MAX_ROWS, self.width, dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+        )
+        blocks = -(-max_model_len // _CANDIDATE_BLOCK)
+        self.cand_bits = torch.zeros(
+            MAX_ROWS, -(-blocks // 32), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.workspace = torch.empty(
+            RADIX_TOPK_WORKSPACE_SIZE, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device
+        )
+        self.empty = torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def for_ops(
+        cls, ops: list[SparseAttnIndexer], device: torch.device
+    ) -> "FusedDecodeIndexer":
+        """The buffers shared by ``ops``: ratio-1 and ratio-2 indexers have
+        different row lengths, so they are sized for the longest."""
+        return cls(max(op.max_model_len for op in ops), device)
+
+    def warm_up(self, query_len: int, cand_k: int) -> None:
+        """Compile the kernels of every request count before graph capture."""
+        for masked in (False, True):
+            _compiled("logits", query_len, 1, masked)
+        _compiled("select", cand_k, self.width)
+
+    def serves(self, metadata: Any, query_len: int) -> bool:
+        """Whether a step's indexer ``metadata`` is a uniform decode the
+        kernels take, ``query_len`` rows per request, whose rows fit the
+        logits buffer (host fields only)."""
+        decode = getattr(metadata, "decode", None)
+        rows = getattr(metadata, "num_decode_tokens", 0)
+        return (
+            decode is not None
+            and metadata.num_prefills == 0
+            and metadata.max_seq_len <= self.width
+            and decode.indices is None
+            and decode.global_seq_lens is None
+            and 0 < query_len <= 8
+            and 0 < rows <= MAX_ROWS
+            and rows % query_len == 0
+        )
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        op: SparseAttnIndexer,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        weights: torch.Tensor,
+        metadata: Any,
+        query_len: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        """The step's top-k indices of ``op`` into its ``topk_indices_buffer``
+        (and on its candidate source, the candidate blocks and bitmap), for
+        rows of ``query_len`` per request."""
+        decode = metadata.decode
+        rows = metadata.num_decode_tokens
+        requests = rows // query_len
+        assert q.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn and q.shape[1:] == (_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM)
+        k_cache = op.k_cache.kv_cache
+        page = k_cache.shape[1]
+        seq_lens = decode.seq_lens.reshape(-1)[:rows]
+        block_table = decode.block_table
+        # About one CTA per SM over the requests; each strides over its
+        # request's tiles up to that request's length.
+        tiles_per_cta = 1
+        chunks = max(1, 132 // requests)
+        candidates = op.candidate_blocks
+        masked = candidates is not None and not op.candidate_write
+        _launch(
+            "logits",
+            (query_len, tiles_per_cta, masked),
+            q,
+            weights,
+            k_cache,
+            ("i64", k_cache.stride(0)),
+            page.bit_length() - 1,
+            block_table,
+            block_table.stride(0),
+            seq_lens,
+            self.logits,
+            self.width,
+            self.cand_bits if masked else self.empty,
+            self.cand_bits.stride(0) if masked else 0,
+            chunks,
+            requests,
+        )
+        if candidates is not None and op.candidate_write:
+            blocks = candidates[:rows]
+            _launch(
+                "select",
+                (blocks.shape[1], self.width),
+                self.logits,
+                self.width,
+                seq_lens,
+                blocks,
+                blocks.stride(0),
+                self.cand_bits,
+                self.cand_bits.stride(0),
+                rows,
+            )
+        torch.ops._C.cooperative_topk(
+            self.logits[:rows],
+            seq_lens.view(-1, 1),
+            op.topk_indices_buffer[:rows, :_TOP_K],
+            self.workspace,
+            _TOP_K,
+            metadata.max_seq_len,
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CuTe DSL SM90 FP8 indexer logits, all verify rows of a request sharing each
+index-K tile (native next_n).
+
+logits[t, p] = sum_h relu((q[t,h] . k[p]) * kscale[p]) * w[t,h]   for p < seq[t]
+             = -inf                                               otherwise
+
+One FP8 WGMMA per 64-position tile: A = K tile (64 x 128 e4m3, SW128 K-major,
+cp.async-gathered from the paged 132 B-record cache), B = the request's
+R x 32 query heads (R*32 x 128 e4m3). The head reduction is a register +
+quad-shuffle sum in the epilogue. Optional candidate mask (per-row bitmap of
+8-position candidate blocks): non-candidate positions get -inf and tiles with
+no candidate for any row are skipped. Grid (chunks, requests), 128 threads,
+PDL (early trigger)."""
+
+import math
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.utils.hopper_helpers as sm90_utils_basic
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, const_expr
+from cutlass.cute.nvgpu import warpgroup
+from cutlass.utils import LayoutEnum
+from quack import layout_utils, sm90_utils
+
+from .indexer_ptx import (
+    cp_async4,
+    cp_async16,
+    cp_async_commit,
+    cp_async_wait,
+    ld_f32,
+    ld_nc_b32,
+    ld_shared_f32,
+    st_global_f32,
+)
+
+TM = 64  # positions per tile
+D = 128
+HQ = 32
+
+
+class IdxLogits:
+    def __init__(
+        self, R: int = 6, tiles_per_cta: int = 1, stages: int = 3, cand: bool = False
+    ):
+        assert 1 <= R <= 8
+        self.R = R
+        self.N = R * HQ
+        self.TPC = tiles_per_cta
+        self.ST = stages
+        self.cand = cand
+        self.dt = cutlass.Float8E4M3FN
+
+    def _layout(self, rows, stages=None):
+        atom = warpgroup.make_smem_layout_atom(
+            sm90_utils_basic.get_smem_layout_atom(LayoutEnum.ROW_MAJOR, self.dt, D),
+            self.dt,
+        )
+        shape = (rows, D) if stages is None else (rows, D, stages)
+        return cute.tile_to_shape(
+            atom, shape, order=(0, 1) if stages is None else (0, 1, 2)
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        q: Int64,
+        w: Int64,
+        kc: Int64,
+        kc_bs: Int64,
+        pshift: Int32,
+        btab: Int64,
+        btab_st: Int32,
+        seq: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        out_st: Int32,
+        cbits: Int64,
+        cbits_st: Int32,
+        nchunks: Int32,
+        B: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        lA = self._layout(TM, self.ST)
+        lB = self._layout(self.N)
+        mma = sm90_utils_basic.make_trivial_tiled_mma(
+            self.dt,
+            self.dt,
+            warpgroup.OperandMajorMode.K,
+            warpgroup.OperandMajorMode.K,
+            Float32,
+            atom_layout_mnk=(1, 1, 1),
+            tiler_mn=(TM, self.N),
+        )
+
+        @cute.struct
+        class Smem:
+            sA: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[self.dt, cute.cosize(lA)], 1024]
+            sB: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[self.dt, cute.cosize(lB)], 1024]
+            sS: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, TM * self.ST]
+            sSeq: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 8]
+
+        self.kernel(
+            q,
+            w,
+            kc,
+            kc_bs,
+            pshift,
+            btab,
+            btab_st,
+            seq,
+            out,
+            out_st,
+            cbits,
+            cbits_st,
+            nchunks,
+            lA,
+            lB,
+            mma,
+            Smem,
+        ).launch(grid=[nchunks, B, 1], block=[128, 1, 1], stream=stream, use_pdl=True)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        q: Int64,
+        w: Int64,
+        kc: Int64,
+        kc_bs: Int64,
+        pshift: Int32,
+        btab: Int64,
+        btab_st: Int32,
+        seq: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        out_st: Int32,
+        cbits: Int64,
+        cbits_st: Int32,
+        nchunks: Int32,
+        sA_l: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sB_l: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        mma: cute.TiledMma,
+        Smem: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ):
+        R, N, ST = self.R, self.N, self.ST
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        ck, b, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        warp = tid // 32  # noqa: F841
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        st = smem.allocate(Smem)
+        sA = st.sA.get_tensor(sA_l.outer, swizzle=sA_l.inner)

+                cid = it * 128 + tid

+                    n = cid // 8
+                    c = cid % 8

+            wr = cute.make_rmem_tensor(ncol, Float32)
+            for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(ncol):
+                n = tC[0, c][1]
+                wr[c] = ld_f32(w + Int64(t0 * HQ + n) * 4)
+            tA = thr.make_fragment_A(thr.partition_A(sA))
+            tB = thr.make_fragment_B(thr.partition_B(sB))
+            for i in cutlass.range(nt, unroll=1):
+                stg = i % ST
+                if i + ST - 1 < nt:
+                    self._issue(
+                        (i + ST - 1) % ST,
+                        ck + (i + ST - 1) * nchunks,
+                        kc,
+                        kc_bs,
+                        pshift,
+                        page,
+                        prow,
+                        a_addr,
+                        s_addr,
+                        tid,
+                        lmax,
+                    )
+                cp_async_commit()
+                cp_async_wait(ST - 1)
+                cute.arch.fence_view_async_shared()
+                cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=1, number_of_threads=128)
+                acc = cute.make_rmem_tensor(thr.partition_shape_C((TM, N)), Float32)
+                sm90_utils.gemm(
+                    mma, acc, tA[None, None, None, stg], tB, zero_init=True, wg_wait=0
+                )
+                a_mn = layout_utils.reshape_acc_to_mn(acc)
+                tile = ck + i * nchunks

+                    ml = tC[r, 0][0]
+                    p = tile * TM + ml
+                    ks = ld_shared_f32(s_addr + (stg * TM + ml) * 4)
+                    rs = cute.make_rmem_tensor(R, Float32)
+                    rs.fill(0.0)
+                    for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(ncol):
+                        j = (tC[r, c][1]) // HQ  # noqa: F841
+                        v = a_mn[r, c] * ks
+                        v = cutlass.max(v, Float32(0.0))
+                        rs[c // (ncol // R)] = rs[c // (ncol // R)] + v * wr[c]
+                    for jj in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+                        x = rs[jj]
+                        x = x + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(x, offset=1)

+                                out + (Int64(t0 + jj) * out_st + Int64(p)) * 4, x
+                            )
+                cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=1, number_of_threads=128)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _swz(self, n: Int32, c: Int32) -> Int32:
+        """Byte offset of 16 B chunk c of row n in a SW128 K-major fp8 tile (128 B rows)."""  # noqa: E501
+        return (n // 8) * 1024 + (n % 8) * 128 + ((c ^ (n % 8)) * 16)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _issue(
+        self,
+        stg,
+        tile,
+        kc: Int64,
+        kc_bs: Int64,
+        pshift: Int32,
+        page: Int32,
+        prow: Int64,
+        a_addr: Int32,
+        s_addr: Int32,
+        tid: Int32,
+        lmax: Int32,
+    ):
+        base = a_addr + stg * (TM * D)
+        for it in cutlass.range_constexpr(TM * 8 // 128):
+            cid = it * 128 + tid
+            m = cid // 8
+            c = cid % 8
+            p = cutlass.min(tile * TM + m, lmax - 1)
+            blk = ld_nc_b32(prow + Int64(p >> pshift) * 4)
+            rec = kc + Int64(blk) * kc_bs + Int64((p & (page - 1)) * D + c * 16)
+            cp_async16(base + self._swz(m, c), rec)
+        if tid < TM:
+            p = cutlass.min(tile * TM + tid, lmax - 1)
+            blk = ld_nc_b32(prow + Int64(p >> pshift) * 4)
+            cp_async4(
+                s_addr + (stg * TM + tid) * 4,
+                kc + Int64(blk) * kc_bs + Int64(page * D + (p & (page - 1)) * 4),
+            )
