+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CuTe DSL top-k per row, one CTA (512 threads) per row, values held in
+registers (NPT per thread):
+
+1. block min/max of the finite values;
+2. 4096-bin *linear* histogram over [min, max] (bin 0 = -inf), so atomics
+   spread out instead of piling on a few exponent bins;
+3. suffix scan -> boundary bin b*: everything above is selected directly;
+4. the boundary bin's elements (few: the threshold sits in the sparse upper
+   tail) are ranked exactly in smem (ties -> lower index first); a refinement
+   histogram pass handles crowded boundary bins.
+
+mode "topk": out = indices of the K largest values of logits[t, :seq[t]].
+mode "blocks": candidate write over block maxima of 8 (newest block pinned to
++inf), plus a bitmap of the selected blocks.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint32
+
+from .indexer_ptx import ld_f32, ld_nc_b32, red_or_b32, st_global_b32
+
+NT = 512
+NB = 4096
+CB = 8
+CAND = 1024
+
+
+class IdxSelect2:
+    def __init__(self, K: int = 512, max_len: int = 16384):
+        self.K = K
+        n = (max_len + CB - 1) // CB
+        self.NPT = max(1, (n + NT - 1) // NT)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        logits: Int64,
+        lst: Int32,
+        seq: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        ost: Int32,
+        cbits: Int64,
+        cbst: Int32,
+        T: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        @cute.struct
+        class Smem:
+            hist: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, NB]
+            pre: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, NT]
+            red: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, 64]
+            wsum: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 16]
+            ctl: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 8]
+            cv: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, CAND]
+            ci: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, CAND]
+            so: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 2048]
+
+        self.kernel(logits, lst, seq, out, ost, cbits, cbst, Smem).launch(
+            grid=[T, 1, 1], block=[NT, 1, 1], stream=stream, use_pdl=True
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _val(self, logits: Int64, row: Int64, i: Int32, Lp: Int32) -> Float32:
+        v = Float32(-math.inf)
+        nan = False
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(CB):
+            p = i * CB + e
+            if p < Lp:
+                x = ld_f32(logits + (row + Int64(p)) * 4)
+                if x != x:
+                    nan = True
+                v = cutlass.max(v, x)
+        if nan or i == (Lp - 1) // CB:
+            v = Float32(math.inf)
+        return v
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _setbit(self, cbits: Int64, t: Int32, cbst: Int32, i: Int32):
+        red_or_b32(
+            cbits + (Int64(t) * cbst + Int64(i // 32)) * 4,
+            Uint32(1) << Uint32(i % 32),
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _bin(self, v: Float32, lo: Float32, sc: Float32) -> Int32:
+        b = Int32(0)
+        if v == Float32(math.inf):
+            b = Int32(NB - 1)
+        elif v > Float32(-math.inf):
+            x = (v - lo) * sc
+            b = 1 + Int32(cutlass.min(cutlass.max(x, Float32(0.0)), Float32(NB - 3)))
+        return b
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _bmax(
+        self, x: Float32, red, tid, lane, warp, slot: cutlass.Constexpr
+    ) -> Float32:
+        for o in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+            x = cutlass.max(x, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(x, offset=1 << o))
+        if lane == 0:
+            red[slot * 16 + warp] = x
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        y = red[slot * 16]
+        for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, NT // 32):
+            y = cutlass.max(y, red[slot * 16 + w])
+        return y
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        logits: Int64,
+        lst: Int32,
+        seq: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        ost: Int32,
+        cbits: Int64,
+        cbst: Int32,
+        Smem: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ):
+        K, NPT = self.K, self.NPT
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        t, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        warp = tid // 32
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        st = smem.allocate(Smem)
+        hist = st.hist.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(NB))
+        pre = st.pre.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(NT))
+        red = st.red.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(64))
+        wsum = st.wsum.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(16))
+        ctl = st.ctl.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(8))
+        cv = st.cv.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(CAND))
+        ci = st.ci.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(CAND))
+        so = st.so.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(2048))
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(NB // NT):
+            hist[i * NT + tid] = 0
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        Lp = ld_nc_b32(seq + Int64(t) * 4)
+        L = (Lp + CB - 1) // CB
+        for i in cutlass.range(tid, cbst, NT, unroll=1):
+            st_global_b32(cbits + (Int64(t) * cbst + Int64(i)) * 4, Uint32(0))
+        row = Int64(t) * Int64(lst)
+        orow = out + Int64(t) * Int64(ost) * 4
+        if L <= K:
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            for i in cutlass.range(tid, K, NT, unroll=1):
+                v = Int32(-1)
+                if i < L:
+                    v = i
+                    self._setbit(cbits, t, cbst, i)
+                st_global_b32(orow + Int64(i) * 4, Uint32(v))
+        else:
+            vals = cute.make_rmem_tensor(NPT, Float32)
+            hi = Float32(-math.inf)
+            nlo = Float32(-math.inf)  # max of -v over finite values (= -min)
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(NPT):
+                i = k * NT + tid
+                v = Float32(-math.inf)
+                if i < L:
+                    v = self._val(logits, row, i, Lp)
+                vals[k] = v
+                if v > Float32(-math.inf) and v < Float32(math.inf):
+                    hi = cutlass.max(hi, v)
+                    nlo = cutlass.max(nlo, -v)
+            hi = self._bmax(hi, red, tid, lane, warp, 0)
+            lo = -self._bmax(nlo, red, tid, lane, warp, 1)
+            sc = Float32(0.0)
+            if hi > lo:
+                sc = Float32(NB - 3) / (hi - lo)
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(NPT):
+                if k * NT + tid < L:
+                    cute.arch.atomic_add(
+                        hist.iterator + self._bin(vals[k], lo, sc),
+                        Int32(1),
+                        scope="cta",
+                    )
+            if tid == 0:
+                ctl[2] = 0
+                ctl[3] = 0
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            # suffix scan over bins (descending); thread owns 8 bins
+            s = Int32(0)
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(NB // NT):
+                s += hist[tid * (NB // NT) + e]
+            pre[NT - 1 - tid] = s
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            x = pre[tid]
+            inc = x
+            for o in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                y = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_up(inc, offset=1 << o, mask_and_clamp=0)
+                if lane >= (1 << o):
+                    inc += y
+            if lane == 31:
+                wsum[warp] = inc
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            woff = Int32(0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(NT // 32):
+                if w < warp:
+                    woff += wsum[w]
+            excl = woff + inc - x
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            pre[tid] = excl
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            above = pre[NT - 1 - tid]
+            if above < K and above + s >= K:
+                acc = above
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(NB // NT):
+                    bi = tid * (NB // NT) + (NB // NT - 1 - e)
+                    hv = hist[bi]
+                    if acc < K and acc + hv >= K:
+                        ctl[0] = bi
+                        ctl[1] = K - acc
+                    acc += hv
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            bstar = ctl[0]
+            need = ctl[1]
+            ngt = K - need
+            # classify: count per thread, one block scan, then write at offsets
+            cnt = Int32(0)  # (gt << 16) | eq
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(NPT):
+                if k * NT + tid < L:
+                    b = self._bin(vals[k], lo, sc)
+                    if b > bstar:
+                        cnt += Int32(1 << 16)
+                    elif b == bstar:
+                        cnt += 1
+            inc2 = cnt
+            for o in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                y = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_up(inc2, offset=1 << o, mask_and_clamp=0)
+                if lane >= (1 << o):
+                    inc2 += y
+            if lane == 31:
+                wsum[warp] = inc2
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            wo = Int32(0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(NT // 32):
+                if w < warp:
+                    wo += wsum[w]
+            ex = wo + inc2 - cnt
+            pg = ex >> 16
+            pe = ex & 0xFFFF
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(NPT):
+                i = k * NT + tid
+                if i < L:
+                    b = self._bin(vals[k], lo, sc)
+                    if b > bstar:
+                        so[pg] = i
+                        pg += 1
+                    elif b == bstar:
+                        if pe < CAND:
+                            cv[pe] = vals[k]
+                            ci[pe] = i
+                        pe += 1
+            if tid == NT - 1:
+                ctl[3] = pe
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            nc = cutlass.min(ctl[3], CAND)
+            # exact rank inside the boundary bin (value desc, then index asc)
+            for c in cutlass.range(tid, nc, NT, unroll=1):
+                v = cv[c]
+                ii = ci[c]
+                rank = Int32(0)
+                for d in cutlass.range(nc, unroll=4):
+                    vd = cv[d]
+                    if vd > v or (vd == v and ci[d] < ii):
+                        rank += 1
+                if rank < need:
+                    so[ngt + rank] = ii
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            for i in cutlass.range(tid, K, NT, unroll=1):
+                oi = so[i]
+                st_global_b32(orow + Int64(i) * 4, Uint32(oi))
+                self._setbit(cbits, t, cbst, oi)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""PTX helpers of the fused decode indexer kernels (``indexer_cute``)."""
+
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint32
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import T, dsl_user_op
+
+
+def _asm(ret, args, s, cons, side=False):
+    return llvm.inline_asm(
+        ret,
+        args,
+        s,
+        cons,
+        has_side_effects=side,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def ld_nc_b32(addr: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Int32:
+    return Int32(
+        _asm(
+            T.i32(),
+            [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+            "ld.global.nc.b32 $0, [$1];",
+            "=r,l",
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def ld_f32(addr: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    return Float32(
+        _asm(
+            T.f32(),
+            [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+            "ld.global.nc.f32 $0, [$1];",
+            "=f,l",
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def st_global_b32(addr: Int64, a: Uint32, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Uint32(a).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "st.global.b32 [$0], $1;",
+        "l,r",
+        side=True,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def st_global_u64(addr: Int64, v: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Int64(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "st.global.u64 [$0], $1;",
+        "l,l",
+        side=True,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def st_global_f32(addr: Int64, v: Float32, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Float32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "st.global.f32 [$0], $1;",
+        "l,f",
+        side=True,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def cp_async16(dst: Int32, src: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [Int32(dst).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Int64(src).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "cp.async.cg.shared.global [$0], [$1], 16;",
+        "r,l",
+        side=True,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def cp_async4(dst: Int32, src: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [Int32(dst).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Int64(src).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "cp.async.ca.shared.global [$0], [$1], 4;",
+        "r,l",
+        side=True,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def cp_async_commit(*, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(None, [], "cp.async.commit_group;", "", side=True)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def cp_async_wait(n: int, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(None, [], f"cp.async.wait_group {n};", "", side=True)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def ld_shared_f32(addr: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    return Float32(
+        _asm(
+            T.f32(),
+            [Int32(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+            "ld.shared.f32 $0, [$1];",
+            "=f,r",
+            side=True,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def red_or_b32(addr: Int64, v: Uint32, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Uint32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "red.global.or.b32 [$0], $1;",
+        "l,r",
+        side=True,
+    )

+"""The kernel choices of a Hopper executor step, one function per kernel.
+
+Each function runs a Hopper low-batch kernel for the rows it serves and the
+stock kernel of the stock layer otherwise. Every Hopper kernel reads the
+tensors the stock layer reads, in place (Humming W8A16 dense weights, Humming
+W4A8 experts, the FlashMLA KV and index caches), so every step outside the
+executor and every prefill keeps running the stock forward on a single copy of
+the weights; ``wo_a``, which the stock SM90 layer keeps only as BF16, is the one
+exception (``dense.fp8_wo_a``).
+
+Each layer's low-batch kernels are providers (``DenseProvider``), one per layer
+and seam, built with the executor: today ``dense.DenseFp8Linear`` up to
+``dense.MAX_ROWS`` rows; a weight-preloading or fused kernel replaces one by

+    all_reduce: "BoundaryAllReduce | None",

+    """``wo_b`` of the ``wo_a`` output: N=5120, K=2048. Its TP-partial output
+    goes to the next boundary's fused all-reduce; where the CuTe kernel runs,
+    it also publishes into that all-reduce's mailbox."""
+    linear = linears.wo_b

+def _wo_b_partial(attn: DeepseekV4Attention, z: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The stock ``wo_b`` without the all-reduce of a ``wo_b`` that reduces its
+    output (the DSpark draft's stock layers)."""
+    wo_b = attn.wo_b
+    if not wo_b.reduce_results:
+        return attn._wo_b_proj(z)

+def o_proj(
+    attn: DeepseekV4Attention,
+    linears: AttentionLinears,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    all_reduce: "BoundaryAllReduce | None",

+    """The output projection of the attention output ``out`` (padded heads):
+    inverse RoPE, the grouped ``wo_a`` (FP8, or the stock BF16 bmm on the
+    weight dequantized at load), then ``wo_b``."""
+
+    def project(z: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return wo_b(attn, linears, z, all_reduce)

+    if not _serves(linears.wo_a, out.shape[0]):
+        return dsv41_o_proj(attn, out, positions, wo_b_proj=project)

+    # [tokens, groups, heads_per_group * head_dim], group-major in memory.
+    rotated, _ = fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant(
+        out[:, : attn.n_local_heads],
+        positions,
+        attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+        n_groups=attn.n_local_groups,
+        heads_per_group=attn.n_local_heads // attn.n_local_groups,
+        nope_dim=attn.nope_head_dim,
+        rope_dim=attn.rope_head_dim,
+        quantize=False,
+    )
+    return project(linears.wo_a(rotated))

+@dataclass
+class SharedMlp:
+    """The low-batch providers of a MoE layer's shared expert MLP."""
+
+    mlp: nn.Module
+    gate_up: DenseProvider
+    down: DenseProvider

+    @classmethod

+        mlp = ffn.shared_experts
+        if mlp is None:
+            return None
+        gate_up = DenseFp8Linear.of("shared_gate_up", mlp.gate_up_proj)
+        down = DenseFp8Linear.of("shared_down", mlp.down_proj)
+        if gate_up is None or down is None:
+            return None
+        return cls(mlp, gate_up, down)
+
+    def serves(self, rows: int) -> bool:
+        return self.gate_up.serves(rows) and self.down.serves(rows)

+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``DeepseekV4MLP.forward``: gate/up, clamped SiLU-and-mul, down."""
+        return self.down(self.mlp.act_fn(self.gate_up(x)))

+        """Within the block, the MLP's forward (which the MoE runner calls,
+        on its shared-expert stream) runs ``forward``."""
+        self.mlp.forward = self.forward
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            del self.mlp.forward

+def shared_installed(
+    shared: SharedMlp | None, rows: int
+) -> AbstractContextManager[None]:
+    """``shared.installed()`` where its calls serve ``rows`` rows."""
+    if shared is None or not shared.serves(rows):
+        return nullcontext()
+    return shared.installed()

+def moe(
+    ffn: "DeepseekV4MoE",
+    shared: SharedMlp | None,
+    routed: HopperLowBatchMoE | None,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,

+    """The MoE layer's TP-partial output, or its routed output left
+    unfinalized with the shared output.
+
+    Up to ``moe.MAX_ROWS`` rows the routed experts run the low-batch kernel
+    (``routed``), from the stock router's logits (on hash-routed layers, its
+    top-k), and stop before the top-k reduction: the next boundary's fused
+    all-reduce + mHC folds the reduction and the shared-expert add into its
+    publish (``AllReduceMHC.finalize``). The kernel also runs the shared expert
+    up to ``moe.SHARED_MAX_ROWS`` rows; above that the stock shared expert runs
+    on its side stream, on the low-batch dense calls where they serve. Larger
+    calls run the stock MoE.

+    rows = x.shape[0]
+    if routed is None or not routed.serves(rows):
+        with shared_installed(shared, rows):
+            return ffn(x, input_ids, None)
+    runner = ffn.experts
+    runner.routed_experts._ensure_moe_quant_config_init()
+    side = runner._shared_experts
+    fused = routed.fuses_shared(rows)
+    overlapping = False
+    with shared_installed(shared, rows):
+        if not fused:
+            assert side is not None
+            overlapping = side.maybe_forward_async(x)
+        router_logits, _ = runner.gate(x)
+        if not fused:
+            runner._maybe_apply_shared_experts(x, SharedExpertsOrder.NO_OVERLAP)
+    if routed.hash_routed:
+        topk_weights, topk_ids = runner.router.select_experts(
+            hidden_states=x,
+            router_logits=router_logits,
+            topk_indices_dtype=runner._quant_method.topk_indices_dtype,
+            input_ids=input_ids,

+        linear = linears.get(engram)

+            return engram.wkv(x)
+        out = linear(x)
+        if engram.wkv.gather_output and engram.wkv.tp_size > 1:
+            out = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(out)
+        return out

+"""CuTe DSL kernels of the Hopper small-batch sparse-MLA decode
+(``mla_small``), on the FlashMLA FP8 caches (584-byte V4 records). A row group
+is up to 64 // H verify rows of one request, whose H heads each share one
+64-row WGMMA tile.
+
+- ``UnionBuild``: per row group, the union of its rows' SWA slots (up to
+  ``NSWB`` 64-key blocks) and a per-key row mask.
+- ``CuPrep3``: per row group, the union of its rows' compressed top-k slots (up
+  to ``NBC`` blocks), optionally mapped from the indexer's local indices
+  through the compressed block table, dequantized into fp16 tile images, with
+  a per-key visibility byte.
+- ``SmallDecode``: one CTA per (row group, block); a normalized BF16 partial
+  and its log-sum-exp terms per row.
+- ``Combine``: the partials of each row merged with the attention sink.
+
+``CuPrep3``, ``SmallDecode`` and ``Combine`` launch with programmatic
+dependent launch: each releases its dependents at entry and waits for its
+predecessor before reading its outputs."""

+DATA_TOK = 576

+NBC = 32  # max compressed blocks per group (4 rows x 512 / 64)

+class SparseMlaDecodeSm90:
+    def __init__(self, H: int = 16, num_stages: int = 2, num_splits: int = 1):
+        assert BM % H == 0
+        self.H = H
+        self.rpg = BM // H
+        self.num_stages = num_stages
+        self.num_splits = num_splits
+        self.dtype = cutlass.Float16
+
+    def _smem_layout(self, rows, cols, stages=None):
+        atom = warpgroup.make_smem_layout_atom(
+            sm90_utils_basic.get_smem_layout_atom(
+                LayoutEnum.ROW_MAJOR, self.dtype, cols
+            ),
+            self.dtype,
+        )
+        shape = (rows, cols) if stages is None else (rows, cols, stages)
+        order = (0, 1) if stages is None else (0, 1, 2)
+        return cute.tile_to_shape(atom, shape, order=order)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _swz(self, m: Int32, c: Int32) -> Int32:
+        """Element offset of 16 B chunk c (8 dims) of row m in a SW128 K-major
+        bf16 tile tiled rows-first: atoms of 8 rows x 64 dims (512 elements)."""
+        return (
+            ((m // 8) + (c // 8) * (BM // 8)) * 512
+            + (m % 8) * 64
+            + (((c % 8) ^ (m % 8)) * 8)
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _load_token(
+        self,
+        v: Int32,
+        ch: Int32,
+        raw: cute.Tensor,
+        scl: cute.Tensor,
+        rnd: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        swa_ptr: Int64,
+        swa_bs: Int64,
+        swa_page: Int32,
+        ex_ptr: Int64,
+        ex_bs: Int64,
+        ex_page: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Issue the 16 B loads of one key's record (4 threads per key, `ch` =
+        16 B lane within each 64-dim tile) into registers."""
+        valid = v != -1
+        slot = v
+        base = swa_ptr
+        bs = swa_bs
+        page = swa_page
+        if v < -1:
+            slot = -2 - v
+            base = ex_ptr
+            bs = ex_bs
+            page = ex_page
+        if not valid:
+            slot = 0
+        blkno = slot >> page
+        rel = slot & ((1 << page) - 1)
+        blk_base = base + Int64(blkno) * bs
+        data = blk_base + Int64(rel * DATA_TOK)
+        lo, hi = ld_nc_v2(blk_base + Int64((DATA_TOK << page) + rel * 8))
+        scl[rnd * 2] = lo
+        scl[rnd * 2 + 1] = hi
+        o = rnd * 36
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(7):
+            w0, w1, w2, w3 = ld_nc_v4(data + (t * 64 + ch * 16))
+            raw[o + t * 4 + 0] = w0
+            raw[o + t * 4 + 1] = w1
+            raw[o + t * 4 + 2] = w2
+            raw[o + t * 4 + 3] = w3
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            w0, w1, w2, w3 = ld_nc_v4(data + (D_NOPE + ch * 16 + t * 64))
+            raw[o + 28 + t * 4 + 0] = w0
+            raw[o + 28 + t * 4 + 1] = w1
+            raw[o + 28 + t * 4 + 2] = w2
+            raw[o + 28 + t * 4 + 3] = w3
+

+class _Common(SparseMlaDecodeSm90):
+    @cute.jit
+    def _store_token_any(
+        self,
+        valid,
+        tk: Int32,
+        ch: Int32,
+        base,
+        raw: cute.Tensor,
+        scl: cute.Tensor,
+        rnd: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        glob: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ):
+        """Dequantise one key into row tk of a SW128 K-major fp16 tile at
+        `base` (smem address, or global address if `glob`)."""
+        o = rnd * 36
+        if not valid:
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(36):
+                raw[o + k] = Uint32(0)

+        sc_hi = scl[rnd * 2 + 1]

+        x0 = rowo + (((2 * ch) ^ (tk % 8)) * 8) * 2
+        x1 = rowo + (((2 * ch + 1) ^ (tk % 8)) * 8) * 2
+        kk = cute.make_rmem_tensor(7, Int32)

+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(7):
+            e = Int32(0)
+            if const_expr(t < 4):
+                e = Int32((sc_lo >> (8 * t)) & 0xFF)
+            else:
+                e = Int32((sc_hi >> (8 * (t - 4))) & 0xFF)
+            k = cutlass.min(e - 127, 15)
+            kk[t] = k
+            kmin = cutlass.min(kmin, k)
+        two = cute.arch.vote_any_sync(kmin < -14)
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(7):
+            k = kk[t]
+            s1 = Uint32(cutlass.max(k + 15, 1) << 10)
+            s1 = s1 | (s1 << 16)
+            ob = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8, Uint32)
+            if two:
+                k2 = k + 14
+                s2 = Uint32(0x3C00)
+                if k < -14:
+                    s2 = Uint32(0)
+                    if k2 >= -14:
+                        s2 = Uint32((k2 + 15) << 10)
+                    elif k2 >= -24:
+                        s2 = Uint32(1 << (k2 + 24))
+                s2 = s2 | (s2 << 16)

+                    lo, hi = dq_e4m3x4_f16_2(raw[o + t * 4 + j], s1, s2)
+                    ob[2 * j] = lo
+                    ob[2 * j + 1] = hi
+            else:
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    lo, hi = dq_e4m3x4_f16(raw[o + t * 4 + j], s1)
+                    ob[2 * j] = lo
+                    ob[2 * j + 1] = hi
+            self._st16(base, x0 + t * 8192, ob[0], ob[1], ob[2], ob[3], glob)
+            self._st16(base, x1 + t * 8192, ob[4], ob[5], ob[6], ob[7], glob)
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            c0 = D_NOPE // 8 + ch + t * 4
+            self._st16(
+                base,
+                self._swz(tk, c0) * 2,
+                bf16x2_to_f16x2(raw[o + 28 + t * 4]),
+                bf16x2_to_f16x2(raw[o + 29 + t * 4]),
+                bf16x2_to_f16x2(raw[o + 30 + t * 4]),
+                bf16x2_to_f16x2(raw[o + 31 + t * 4]),
+                glob,
+            )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _st16(self, base, off: Int32, a, b, c, d, glob: cutlass.Constexpr):
+        if const_expr(glob):
+            st_global_v4(base + Int64(off), a, b, c, d)
+        else:
+            st_shared_v4(base + off, a, b, c, d)

+            for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(o_mn, mode=[1]) // 2):

+                st_shared_b32(
+                    base + (m * DV + (((n // 8) ^ (m % 8)) * 8) + n % 8) * 2,

+"""The small-batch sparse-MLA decode of a Hopper executor step, up to
+``MAX_ROWS`` rows of uniform verify steps.
+
+FlashMLA pads each row's 16 local heads to a 64-row tile. These kernels
+(``mla_cute``) pack up to four rows of one request into a tile instead, on the
+stock caches, SWA indices and the indexer's local top-k indices:
+
+- At the start of the step, on a side stream, ``UnionBuild`` builds the union
+  of each row group's SWA slots once per SWA KV-cache group.
+- The first layer of an index source (``sparse_index_key``) runs ``CuPrep3``:
+  the union of the group's compressed top-k slots mapped through the compressed
+  block table (``compute_global_topk_indices_and_lens`` fused), dequantized
+  into tile images. The source layer is the first reader of its top-k, so this
+  runs on the forward stream.
+- Each layer runs ``SmallDecode`` and ``Combine`` into heads 0..15 of the stock
+  padded output.
+"""
+
+import math
+from functools import cache
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+
+from ...flashmla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
+from ..attention.sparse_mla import sparse_index_key
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.sparse_mla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_swa import DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata
+
+# Above it FlashMLA's padded tiles are full enough to win.
+MAX_ROWS = 12
+_HEADS = 16
+_ROWS_PER_GROUP = 64 // _HEADS
+_SWA_WIDTH, _TOP_K = 128, 512
+
+
+def _log2(n: int) -> int:
+    assert n > 0 and n & (n - 1) == 0, n
+    return n.bit_length() - 1
+

+@cache
+def _compiled(kind: str, compressed: bool):
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+    from . import mla_cute
+
+    i, p = Int32(1), Int64(0)
+    if kind == "union":
+        kernel: Any = mla_cute.UnionBuild(_ROWS_PER_GROUP)
+        args = [p, i, i, p, p, i, i, p, p, p, p, i, i, i, i]
+    elif kind == "prep":
+        kernel = mla_cute.CuPrep3(_HEADS)
+        args = [p, i, i, p, p, p, p, i, i, p, p, i, p, p, p, i, i, i]
+    elif kind == "decode":
+        kernel = mla_cute.SmallDecode(_HEADS, compressed)
+        args = [p, i, i, p, i, i, p, p, i, p, p, p, i, p, p, p, p, Float32(1.0)]
+        args += [p, p, i, i, i]
+    else:
+        kernel = mla_cute.Combine(_HEADS, compressed)
+        args = [p, p, p, p, i, i, i, i, i]
+    return cute.compile(kernel, *args, make_fake_stream())

+def _launch(kind: str, compressed: bool, *args: Any) -> None:
+    """``kind``'s kernel on the current stream; tensors pass their address,
+    floats and ``("i64", n)`` pass as 64-bit, other ints as Int32."""
+    from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64

+    from vllm.models.common.ops.moe_tail_fusion.primitives import current_cu_stream

+            values.append(Int64(arg.data_ptr()))
+        elif isinstance(arg, tuple):
+            values.append(Int64(arg[1]))
+        elif isinstance(arg, float):
+            values.append(Float32(arg))
+        else:
+            values.append(Int32(arg))

+        """The compressed stage of ``attn``'s index source, prepared by its
+        first layer: an index source's layers are consecutive."""
+        key = self.keys[attn]
+        if key == self._stage_key:
+            return self.stage
+        self._stage_key = key
+        topk = attn.topk_indices_buffer
+        tok2req = swa_metadata.token_to_req_indices
+        valid = swa_metadata.is_valid_token
+        assert topk is not None and tok2req is not None and valid is not None
+        table = attn_metadata.block_table
+        cache = attn._compressed_kv_cache()
+        img, mbits, count = self.stage
+        per_request = -(-self.query_len // _ROWS_PER_GROUP)
+        _launch(
+            "prep",
+            True,
+            topk,
+            topk.stride(0),
+            topk.shape[-1],
+            # The top-k lengths, unused when mapping local indices.
+            tok2req,
+            tok2req,
+            valid,
+            table,
+            table.stride(0),
+            _log2(attn_metadata.block_size // attn.compress_ratio),
+            cache,
+            ("i64", cache.stride(0)),
+            _log2(cache.shape[1]),
+            img,
+            mbits,
+            count,
+            self.query_len,
+            per_request,
+            self.groups,
+        )
+        return self.stage
+
+    def warm_up(self) -> None:
+        """Compile the kernels before CUDA graph capture."""
+        if self.supported:
+            for kind, compressed in (
+                ("union", False),
+                ("prep", True),
+                ("decode", False),
+                ("decode", True),
+                ("combine", False),
+                ("combine", True),
+            ):
+                _compiled(kind, compressed)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Low-batch MoE of the Hopper executor.
+
+``HopperLowBatchMoE`` runs one DeepSeek-V4.1 MoE layer's routed experts, and up
+to ``SHARED_MAX_ROWS`` rows its shared expert, as one persistent CuTe DSL launch
+(``moe_cute.LowBatchMoEKernel``) for up to ``MAX_ROWS`` rows. It reads the
+layer's stock Humming tensors in place: the routed experts' SM90 W4A8 weights
+(MXFP4 x block-FP8 group-128 activations) and the shared expert's W8A16 linears.
+
+The kernel routes the step itself from the stock router's FP32 logits
+(sqrt-softplus plus the correction bias, top-k, renormalized, times the routed
+scaling factor; image sentinel tokens with ``bias_vl``), or takes the stock
+router's top-k ids and weights on hash-routed layers. It stops before the top-k
+reduction: its output is an ``UnfinalizedMoEOutput`` (unweighted BF16 rows per
+(token, expert), FP32 routing weights, int32 route-to-row map) that the next
+boundary's fused all-reduce + mHC finalizes (``AllReduceMHC.finalize``), with
+the shared expert's BF16 output (fused, or from the stock shared expert).
+
+The expert count and top-k are the layer's (384 / 6 in the backbone, 128 / 3
+in the DSpark drafter). Every layer shares one ``MoEWorkspace``: calls are
+ordered on the forward stream, and each boundary consumes its MoE output
+before the next MoE layer runs. The kernel's counters are epoch-stamped or
+reset by their last user, so CUDA graph replays need no reset.
+"""
+
+from functools import cache
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import UnfinalizedMoEOutput
+
+# Rows of the largest call: at 144 rows the kernel with its fused shared
+# expert ties the stock MoE with the shared expert on the side stream (the
+# kernel holds 256).
+MAX_ROWS = 144
+# Calls of up to this many rows give each active expert one chunk of all rows,
+# and split GEMM1's K over CTA pairs that reduce through distributed shared
+# memory (CLUSTER_MAX_ROWS).
+DENSE_MAX_ROWS = 16
+CLUSTER_MAX_ROWS = 16
+# The fused shared expert beats or ties the stock one on its side stream up to
+# here.
+SHARED_MAX_ROWS = 144
+_HIDDEN = 5120
+
+
+def _routed_shapes(experts: int) -> dict[str, tuple[int, ...]]:
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": (experts, 80, 10240),
+        "w13_weight_scale": (experts, 160, 1280),
+        "w13_weight_scale_2": (experts,),
+        "w2_weight": (experts, 10, 40960),
+        "w2_weight_scale": (experts, 20, 5120),
+        "w2_weight_scale_2": (experts,),
+    }
+
+
+def _tensor_map(dtype, address: int, dims, strides, box) -> list[int]:
+    import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+
+    err, tensor_map = cuda.cuTensorMapEncodeTiled(
+        dtype,
+        len(dims),
+        address,
+        [cuda.cuuint64_t(d) for d in dims],
+        [cuda.cuuint64_t(s) for s in strides],
+        [cuda.cuuint32_t(b) for b in box],
+        [cuda.cuuint32_t(1)] * len(dims),
+        cuda.CUtensorMapInterleave.CU_TENSOR_MAP_INTERLEAVE_NONE,
+        cuda.CUtensorMapSwizzle.CU_TENSOR_MAP_SWIZZLE_NONE,
+        cuda.CUtensorMapL2promotion.CU_TENSOR_MAP_L2_PROMOTION_L2_256B,
+        cuda.CUtensorMapFloatOOBfill.CU_TENSOR_MAP_FLOAT_OOB_FILL_NONE,
+    )
+    assert err == cuda.CUresult.CUDA_SUCCESS, err
+    return [v if v < 2**63 else v - 2**64 for v in map(int, tensor_map.opaque)]
+
+
+def _layer_maps(
+    routed: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+    shared: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None,
+    bias_vl: torch.Tensor | None,
+    sentinel_lo: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The kernel's [9, 16] int64 layer blob: TMA tensor maps of the routed
+    w13 / s13 / w2 / s2 and shared gate-up / its scales / down / its scales;
+    row 8: (address, bytes) of the four shared tensors, then the gate weight
+    (unused), ``bias_vl`` addresses and the image sentinel."""
+    import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+
+    u64 = cuda.CUtensorMapDataType.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_UINT64
+    u8 = cuda.CUtensorMapDataType.CU_TENSOR_MAP_DATA_TYPE_UINT8
+    e = routed["w13_weight"].shape[0]
+    w13, s13 = routed["w13_weight"], routed["w13_weight_scale"].view(torch.uint8)
+    w2, s2 = routed["w2_weight"], routed["w2_weight_scale"].view(torch.uint8)
+    blob = torch.zeros(9, 16, dtype=torch.int64)
+    maps = [
+        # w13 [e * 80 + k64][half][pair][2 KB]
+        (u64, w13, [256, 9, 2, e * 80], [2048, 18432, 40960], [256, 1, 2, 4]),
+        # s13 [e * 160 + k32][half][pair][64 B]
+        (u8, s13, [64, 9, 2, e * 160], [64, 576, 1280], [64, 1, 2, 8]),
+        # w2 [e * 10 + k64][block][2 KB]
+        (u64, w2, [256, 80, e * 10], [2048, 163840], [256, 2, 3]),
+        # s2 [e * 20 + k32][block pair][128 B]
+        (u8, s2, [128, 40, e * 20], [128, 5120], [128, 1, 6]),
+    ]
+    if shared is not None:
+        gate_up, gate_up_scale, down, down_scale = shared
+        maps += [
+            (u64, gate_up, [128, 9, 2, 320], [1024, 9216, 20480], [128, 1, 2, 8]),
+            (u8, gate_up_scale, [64, 9, 2, 160], [64, 576, 1280], [64, 1, 2, 4]),
+            (u64, down, [128, 80, 40], [1024, 81920], [128, 2, 6]),
+            (u8, down_scale, [5120, 20], [5120], [128, 3]),
+        ]
+        # The shared tensors' (address, bytes) for the kernel's L2 prefetch.
+        for i, t in enumerate(shared):
+            blob[8, 2 * i] = t.data_ptr()
+            blob[8, 2 * i + 1] = t.numel() * t.element_size()
+    for i, (dtype, t, dims, strides, box) in enumerate(maps):
+        blob[i] = torch.tensor(_tensor_map(dtype, t.data_ptr(), dims, strides, box))
+    blob[8, 9] = 0 if bias_vl is None else bias_vl.data_ptr()
+    blob[8, 10] = sentinel_lo
+    return blob.to(w13.device)
+
+
+class MoEWorkspace:
+    """The buffers of one MoE call, shared by every layer on a device."""
+
+    def __init__(self, device: torch.device) -> None:
+        from .moe_cute import (
+            CHUNK_CAP,
+            ENTP,
+            KT1,
+            MAX_TOPK,
+            MAXM,
+            NG,
+            REC_POS,
+            REC_WORDS,
+            SYNC_WORDS,
+        )
+
+        def zeros(*shape, dtype=torch.uint8):
+            return torch.zeros(*shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+
+        f32, i32 = torch.float32, torch.int32
+        self.xg = zeros(KT1 // 4, NG, 4, 4, 8, 16)
+        self.xsg = zeros(KT1 // 4, ENTP, 2, dtype=f32)
+        self.rec = zeros(REC_WORDS, dtype=i32)
+        self.iq = zeros(3, NG, 3, 4, 8, 16)
+        self.isc = zeros(3, ENTP, 3, dtype=f32)
+        self.part = zeros(CHUNK_CAP, 32, 128, dtype=f32)
+        self.cnt = zeros(32, dtype=i32)
+        self.sync = zeros(SYNC_WORDS, dtype=i32)
+        self.rows = zeros(ENTP, _HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.out = zeros(MAXM, _HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.ids = zeros(MAXM * MAX_TOPK, dtype=i32)
+        self.wts = zeros(MAXM * MAX_TOPK, dtype=f32)
+        self.xgs = zeros(40, MAXM // 8, 8, 8, 16)
+        self.xsgs = zeros(40, MAXM, dtype=f32)
+        self.iqs = zeros(6, MAXM // 8, 12, 8, 16)
+        self.iscs = zeros(6, MAXM, 3, dtype=f32)
+        self.shared = zeros(MAXM, _HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self._rec_pos = REC_POS
+
+    def route_to_row(self, rows: int, top_k: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx`` [rows, top_k] (a view of the
+        record)."""
+        start = self._rec_pos
+        return self.rec[start : start + rows * top_k].view(rows, top_k)
+
+
+_workspaces: dict[torch.device, MoEWorkspace] = {}
+
+
+def workspace(device: torch.device) -> MoEWorkspace:
+    """The device's workspace, allocated on first use (outside graph capture)."""
+    if device not in _workspaces:
+        _workspaces[device] = MoEWorkspace(device)
+    return _workspaces[device]
+
+
+class LaunchConfig(NamedTuple):
+    """A compiled variant of the kernel."""
+
+    experts: int
+    top_k: int
+    ids_mode: bool
+    dense: bool
+    shared: bool
+    image: bool
+    # Split GEMM1's K over CTA pairs (dense calls only).
+    cluster: bool
+    # K chunks of the fused shared expert's GEMM1.
+    shared_chunks: int
+    # GEMM2 ring stages.
+    gemm2_stages: int
+
+
+def launch_config(
+    experts: int, top_k: int, rows: int, ids_mode: bool, shared: bool, image: bool
+) -> LaunchConfig:
+    dense = rows <= DENSE_MAX_ROWS
+    cluster = dense and rows <= CLUSTER_MAX_ROWS
+    return LaunchConfig(
+        experts=experts,
+        top_k=top_k,
+        ids_mode=ids_mode,
+        dense=dense,
+        shared=shared,
+        image=image,
+        cluster=cluster,
+        shared_chunks=10 if cluster else 20,
+        # Above 8 rows the cluster's partial slot takes the fifth stage.
+        gemm2_stages=4 if cluster and rows > 8 else 5,
+    )
+
+
+@cache
+def _compiled(config: LaunchConfig):
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+    from .moe_cute import LowBatchMoEKernel
+
+    kernel = LowBatchMoEKernel(
+        ns2=config.gemm2_stages,
+        ids_mode=config.ids_mode,
+        dense=config.dense,
+        shared=config.shared,
+        image=config.image,
+        cluster=config.cluster,
+        nchs=config.shared_chunks,
+        experts=config.experts,
+        top_k=config.top_k,
+    )
+    zero = Int64(0)
+    return cute.compile(kernel, *([zero] * 23), Int32(1), Int32(1), make_fake_stream())
+
+
+class HopperLowBatchMoE:
+    """The low-batch MoE call of one ``DeepseekV4MoE`` layer."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        routed: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+        shared: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+        bias_vl: torch.Tensor | None,
+        sentinel_lo: int,
+        hash_routed: bool,
+        top_k: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.device = routed["w13_weight"].device
+        self.experts = routed["w13_weight"].shape[0]
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.workspace = workspace(self.device)
+        self.blob = _layer_maps(routed, shared, bias_vl, sentinel_lo)
+        self.scale13 = routed["w13_weight_scale_2"]
+        self.scale2 = routed["w2_weight_scale_2"]
+        self.has_shared = shared is not None
+        # Keep the tensors the blob addresses alive with the layer's.
+        self._tensors = (routed, shared, bias_vl)
+        self.bias = (
+            bias.float().contiguous()
+            if bias is not None
+            else torch.zeros(self.experts, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
+        )
+        self.image = bias_vl is not None and sentinel_lo > 0
+        self.hash_routed = hash_routed
+        self._grid = (
+            2 * torch.cuda.get_device_properties(self.device).multi_processor_count
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def of(cls, ffn: nn.Module) -> "HopperLowBatchMoE | None":
+        """The call of a stock ``DeepseekV4MoE`` on Humming W4A8 experts at TP4
+        (a multiple of 32 experts up to 384, top-k up to 6, sqrt-softplus,
+        renormalized, routed scaling 1.5, SwiGLU limit 10), or None for any
+        other layer."""
+        from .moe_cute import MAX_EXPERTS, MAX_TOPK, ROUTED_SCALING, SWIGLU_LIMIT
+
+        runner = getattr(ffn, "experts", None)
+        experts = getattr(runner, "routed_experts", None)
+        if experts is None or getattr(ffn, "use_native_mega_moe", False):
+            return None
+        params = dict(experts.named_parameters())
+        num_experts = getattr(params.get("w13_weight"), "shape", (0,))[0]
+        top_k = ffn.n_activated_experts
+        if not (
+            0 < num_experts <= MAX_EXPERTS
+            and num_experts % 32 == 0
+            and 0 < top_k <= MAX_TOPK
+        ):
+            return None
+        shapes = _routed_shapes(num_experts)
+        for name, shape in shapes.items():
+            p = params.get(name)
+            if p is None or tuple(p.shape) != shape or not p.is_contiguous():
+                return None
+        if (
+            params["w13_weight"].dtype != torch.int32
+            or params["w13_weight_scale_2"].dtype != torch.float32
+            or params["w2_weight_scale_2"].dtype != torch.float32
+            or ffn.scoring_func != "sqrtsoftplus"
+            or not ffn.renormalize
+            or ffn.routed_scaling_factor != ROUTED_SCALING
+            or ffn.swiglu_limit != SWIGLU_LIMIT
+        ):
+            return None
+        shared = None
+        mlp = getattr(ffn, "shared_experts", None)
+        if mlp is not None:
+            tensors = (
+                mlp.gate_up_proj.weight.view(torch.int32),
+                mlp.gate_up_proj.weight_scale.view(torch.uint8),
+                mlp.down_proj.weight.view(torch.int32),
+                mlp.down_proj.weight_scale.view(torch.uint8),
+            )
+            shared_shapes = ((320, 5120), (160, 1280), (40, 20480), (20, 5120))
+            if all(tuple(t.shape) == s for t, s in zip(tensors, shared_shapes)):
+                shared = tensors
+        gate = ffn.gate
+        return cls(
+            {name: params[name].data for name in shapes},
+            shared,
+            getattr(gate, "e_score_correction_bias", None),
+            getattr(gate, "bias_vl", None),
+            int(getattr(ffn, "image_sentinel_lo", 0)),
+            getattr(gate, "tid2eid", None) is not None,
+            top_k,
+        )
+
+    def serves(self, rows: int) -> bool:
+        return 0 < rows <= MAX_ROWS
+
+    def fuses_shared(self, rows: int) -> bool:
+        return self.has_shared and rows <= SHARED_MAX_ROWS
+
+    def warm_up(self, rows: list[int]) -> None:
+        """Compile the variants calls of ``rows`` rows launch."""
+        for m in rows:
+            if self.serves(m):
+                _compiled(self._config(m, self.hash_routed, self.image))
+
+    def _config(self, rows: int, ids_mode: bool, image: bool) -> LaunchConfig:
+        return launch_config(
+            self.experts,
+            self.top_k,
+            rows,
+            ids_mode,
+            self.fuses_shared(rows),
+            image,
+        )
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[UnfinalizedMoEOutput, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        """The unfinalized routed output of the BF16 MoE input ``x`` [rows,
+        5120], routed from FP32 ``router_logits`` [rows, experts] or, on a
+        hash-routed layer, by the stock router's ``topk_ids`` / ``topk_weights``
+        (scaled); and the fused shared expert's output, or None above
+        ``SHARED_MAX_ROWS`` rows. Both are views of the workspace."""
+        from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+
+        from vllm.models.common.ops.moe_tail_fusion.primitives import current_cu_stream
+
+        rows = x.shape[0]
+        assert self.serves(rows) and x.is_contiguous() and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        ws = self.workspace
+        shared = self.fuses_shared(rows)
+
+        def address(t: torch.Tensor) -> Int64:
+            return Int64(t.data_ptr())
+
+        ids_mode = self.hash_routed
+        image = self.image and not ids_mode and input_ids is not None
+        if ids_mode:
+            assert topk_ids is not None and topk_weights is not None
+            ids = topk_ids.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
+            weights = topk_weights.to(torch.float32).contiguous()
+            logits = bias = x
+        else:
+            assert router_logits is not None and router_logits.shape == (
+                rows,
+                self.experts,
+            )
+            size = rows * self.top_k
+            ids = ws.ids[:size].view(rows, self.top_k)
+            weights = ws.wts[:size].view(rows, self.top_k)
+            logits, bias = router_logits.float().contiguous(), self.bias

+        # would go (the W8A16 shared expert converts its own).
+        xgs = ws.xgs
+        if image:
+            assert input_ids is not None
+            xgs = input_ids.to(torch.int32).contiguous()

+            address(self.blob),
+            address(self.scale13),
+            address(self.scale2),
+            address(ws.xg),
+            address(ws.xsg),
+            address(ws.rec),
+            address(ws.iq),
+            address(ws.isc),
+            address(ws.part),
+            address(ws.cnt),
+            address(ws.sync),
+            address(x),
+            address(ids),
+            address(weights),
+            address(logits),
+            address(bias),
+            address(ws.rows),
+            address(ws.out),
+            address(xgs),
+            address(ws.xsgs),
+            address(ws.iqs),
+            address(ws.iscs),
+            address(ws.shared),
+            Int32(rows),
+            Int32(self._grid),
+            current_cu_stream(),
+        )
+        routed = UnfinalizedMoEOutput(
+            gemm2_permuted=ws.rows,
+            expert_weights=weights[:rows],
+            expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=ws.route_to_row(rows, self.top_k),
+        )
+        return routed, ws.shared[:rows] if shared else None

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Low-batch MoE of DeepSeek-V4.1 at TP4 on SM90, in CuTe DSL: one persistent
+launch per MoE layer (``LowBatchMoEKernel``), reading the layer's stock Humming
+tensors in place (``moe`` builds the tensor maps and runs it).
+
+Roles per CTA (320 threads, 2 CTAs per SM): 8 consumer warps (two wgmma
+warpgroups), a TMA producer warp, a signal warp.
+
+* Front: row CTA ``t < M`` routes token ``t`` (from the router's logits:
+  sqrt-softplus plus the correction bias, top-6, renormalized, times the routed
+  scaling factor; image sentinel tokens with ``bias_vl``; or from given top-k
+  ids and weights), block-FP8 (group 128) quantizes it and publishes it with
+  one counter. Every CTA builds the expert-major row-chunk table in shared
+  memory.
+
+  - Dense mode (``M <= DENSE_MAX_ROWS``): one row chunk per active expert
+    covering all ``M`` tokens (a token mask marks the routed ones), on the
+    token-major quantized rows: no gather.
+  - Entry mode: 8-aligned row chunks of at most 32 routed entries; row CTAs
+    scatter their row into its 6 entry slots.
+
+* GEMM1 (``w13``, MXFP4 x FP8 wgmma): dynamic split-K chunks of (row chunk,
+  gate/up pair) tiles. Each chunk's FP32 partial goes to global memory; the
+  signal warp detects the CTA that completes a tile, whose consumers run the
+  tile's clamped SwiGLU and FP8 intermediate, and publishes a row chunk ready
+  after its 9 pairs.
+* GEMM2 (``w2``): the producer streams ``w2`` tiles into a second ring once its
+  GEMM1 ring is drained; each item waits only for its own row chunk.
+* Shared expert (``shared``): the W8A16 FP8 weights read in place, as f16
+  wgmma A fragments (exact e4m3 to f16 conversion) with the per-32 UE8M0
+  scale applied on each k32 partial, on f16 activations converted from x; an
+  extra row chunk of weight 1 covering every token, written to its own output
+  in token order. Its first weight stages are issued before the grid wait.
+* Output: unweighted BF16 rows per (token, expert) and the
+  route-to-row map in the record: an ``UnfinalizedMoEOutput``, which the next
+  boundary's fused all-reduce + mHC finalizes.
+
+Counters are epoch-stamped or reset by their last user, so repeated calls and
+CUDA graph replays need no host-side reset. The kernel launches with
+programmatic dependent launch.
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint32
+
+from .moe_ptx import (
+    atom_add_acqrel_gpu,
+    atom_add_relaxed,
+    bf16x2_to_f16x2,
+    bf16x2_to_f32x2,
+    bulk_g2s,
+    cluster_sync_all,
+    cvt_bf16x2,
+    cvt_e4m3_word,
+    cvt_e4m3x4,
+    dequant_e2m1x8,
+    e8m0_to_f32,
+    evict_first_policy,

+@cute.jit
+def _promote(
+    N: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    d: cute.Tensor,
+    base: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    acc: cute.Tensor,
+    asb: Int32,
+    stride: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    t: Int32,
+):
+    """Acc += d * scale[col]; scale of entry column c at asb + c * stride."""
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(N // 8):
+        sa = lds_f32(asb + (8 * i + 2 * t) * stride)
+        sb = lds_f32(asb + (8 * i + 2 * t + 1) * stride)
+        acc[4 * i] = acc[4 * i] + d[base + 4 * i] * sa
+        acc[4 * i + 1] = acc[4 * i + 1] + d[base + 4 * i + 1] * sb
+        acc[4 * i + 2] = acc[4 * i + 2] + d[base + 4 * i + 2] * sa
+        acc[4 * i + 3] = acc[4 * i + 3] + d[base + 4 * i + 3] * sb

+@cute.jit
+def _route_row(
+    logits: Int64,
+    bias: Int64,
+    ids: Int64,
+    wts: Int64,
+    r: Int32,
+    lane: Int32,
+    experts: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    top_k: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    """DSv4 top-k of row r (one warp): score = sqrt(softplus), key = score + bias,
+    lowest id on ties; weights = scores / sum x routed scaling."""
+    per_lane = experts // 32
+    sc = cute.make_rmem_tensor((per_lane,), Float32)
+    ky = cute.make_rmem_tensor((per_lane,), Float32)
+    bb = cute.make_rmem_tensor((per_lane,), Float32)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(per_lane):
+        bj0 = ldg_f32(bias + Int64((lane + 32 * j) * 4))
+        lg = ldg_f32(logits + (Int64(r) * experts + lane + 32 * j) * 4)
+        sc[j] = score_of(lg)
+        ky[j] = sc[j] + bj0
+        bb[j] = bj0
+    tot = Float32(0.0)
+    my_id = Int32(0)
+    my_s = Float32(0.0)
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(top_k):
+        bk = ky[0]
+        bj = Int32(0)
+        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, per_lane):
+            if ky[j] > bk:
+                bk = ky[j]
+                bj = Int32(j)
+        bidx = lane + 32 * bj
+        for sh in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+            ok = shfl_xor_f32(bk, 1 << sh)
+            oi = shfl_xor_i32(bidx, 1 << sh)
+            if ok > bk:
+                bk = ok
+                bidx = oi
+            elif ok == bk:
+                if oi < bidx:
+                    bidx = oi
+        owner = bidx % 32
+        s_sel = Float32(0.0)
+        if lane == owner:
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(per_lane):
+                if j == bidx // 32:
+                    s_sel = sc[j]
+                    ky[j] = Float32(-3.0e38)
+        s_sel = shfl_idx_f32(s_sel, owner)
+        tot = tot + s_sel
+        if lane == k:
+            my_id = bidx
+            my_s = s_sel
+    if lane < top_k:
+        wv = my_s * (Float32(ROUTED_SCALING) * rcp(tot))
+        stg_i32(ids + (Int64(r) * top_k + lane) * 4, my_id)
+        stg_f32(wts + (Int64(r) * top_k + lane) * 4, wv)
+

+def red_bytes(ns2):
+    """cluster: rank-1 partial of one tile, 128 rows x 8 (ns2 = 5) or 16 (ns2 <= 4) columns"""  # noqa: E501
+    return 128 * (8 if ns2 >= 5 else 16) * 4

+def smem_bytes(ns1, ns2, cluster=False):
+    u = max(
+        ns1 * SB1 + FRONT_SCRATCH,
+        max(ns1 * SB1, ns2 * SB2) + (red_bytes(ns2) if cluster else 0),
+    )
+    return u + TAB_BYTES + 16 * (ns1 + ns2) + SIG_BYTES

+@cute.jit
+def _min_count(base: Int32) -> Int32:
+    m = lds_acquire(base)
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, NCW):
+        v = lds_acquire(base + w * 4)
+        if v < m:
+            m = v
+    return m

+@cute.jit
+def _ch_tile(ch: Int32, NCH: Int32, tshc: Int32):
+    """(tile, k-chunk index) of chunk ch: the shared tiles' NCHS chunks first,
+    then the routed tiles' NCH chunks."""
+    tsh = tshc // 32
+    nchs = tshc % 32
+    cs = tsh * nchs
+    tile = ch // nchs
+    h = ch % nchs
+    if ch >= cs:
+        tile = tsh + (ch - cs) // NCH
+        h = (ch - cs) % NCH
+    return tile, h
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tile_nch(tile: Int32, NCH: Int32, tshc: Int32) -> Int32:
+    n = NCH
+    if tile < tshc // 32:
+        n = tshc % 32
+    return n
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tile_ch(tile: Int32, h: Int32, NCH: Int32, tshc: Int32) -> Int32:
+    tsh = tshc // 32
+    nchs = tshc % 32
+    ch = tile * nchs + h
+    if tile >= tsh:
+        ch = tsh * nchs + (tile - tsh) * NCH + h
+    return ch

+def _dq_load(
+    wt: Int32, wsa0: Int32, wsa1: Int32, lane: Int32, R: Int32, q: cute.Tensor
+):
+    """Shared-memory half of _dequant: weights word quad + both k32 scales."""
+    v = lds128(wt + R * 512 + lane * 16)
+    q[0] = v[0]
+    q[1] = v[1]
+    q[2] = v[2]
+    q[3] = v[3]
+    q[4] = lds_u16(wsa0)
+    q[5] = lds_u16(wsa1)

+@cute.jit
+def _dq_conv(q: cute.Tensor, af: cute.Tensor):
+    lo0 = dequant_e2m1x8(q[0], q[4] & Uint32(0xFF))
+    hi0 = dequant_e2m1x8(q[1], q[4] >> Uint32(8))
+    lo1 = dequant_e2m1x8(q[2], q[5] & Uint32(0xFF))
+    hi1 = dequant_e2m1x8(q[3], q[5] >> Uint32(8))
+    af[0] = lo0[0]
+    af[1] = hi0[0]
+    af[2] = lo0[1]
+    af[3] = hi0[1]
+    af[4] = lo1[0]
+    af[5] = hi1[0]
+    af[6] = lo1[1]
+    af[7] = hi1[1]

+    @cute.jit
+    def _quant_row(
+        self, x: Int64, r: Int32, tid: Int32, qw: cute.Tensor, qs: cute.Tensor
+    ):
+        """Block-FP8 g128 of row r: thread tid < 160 holds k [32 tid, 32 tid + 32)."""
+        k0 = tid * 32
+        f = cute.make_rmem_tensor((32,), Float32)
+        for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            v = ldg128(x + (Int64(r) * HIDDEN + k0 + 8 * c) * 2)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                lo, hi = bf16x2_to_f32x2(v[i])
+                f[8 * c + 2 * i] = lo
+                f[8 * c + 2 * i + 1] = hi
+        amax = fabs(f[0])
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, 32):
+            amax = fmax(amax, fabs(f[i]))
+        for sh in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            amax = fmax(amax, shfl_xor_f32(amax, 1 << sh))
+        amax = fmax(amax, Float32(1e-12))
+        qs[0] = amax * Float32(1.0 / 448.0)
+        inv = Float32(448.0) / amax
+        for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            qw[w] = cvt_e4m3x4(
+                f[4 * w] * inv,
+                f[4 * w + 1] * inv,
+                f[4 * w + 2] * inv,
+                f[4 * w + 3] * inv,

+    @cute.jit
+    def _store_xrow(
+        self,
+        xg: Int64,
+        xsg: Int64,
+        ent: Int32,
+        tid: Int32,
+        qw: cute.Tensor,
+        qs: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        """Quantized row slice of thread tid into GEMM1 B slot ``ent``."""
+        k0 = tid * 32
+        kt = k0 // 64
+        kt4 = kt // 4  # noqa: F841
+        kti = kt % 4  # noqa: F841
+        kc = (k0 % 64) // 16  # noqa: F841
+        b128 = k0 // 128
+        # [stage (k256)][entry/8][k32 slice][8 entries][32 B]; halves swapped
+        # for entries 4-7 (32 B swizzle). Lane pair (2j, 2j + 1) = slices
+        # (s, s + 1) of one stage: each instruction writes one whole slice row.
+        n = ent % 8
+        sw = (n // 4) % 2
+        se = (tid % 8) - (tid % 2)

+        s1 = qw[1]
+        s2 = qw[2]
+        s3 = qw[3]

+            s1 = qw[5]
+            s2 = qw[6]
+            s3 = qw[7]
+        r0 = Uint32(shfl_xor_i32(Int32(s0), 1))

+    @cute.jit
+    def _front_dense(
+        self,
+        ids: Int64,
+        cnt: Int64,
+        M: Int32,
+        tid: Int32,
+        warp: Int32,
+        lane: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        s_tmask: Int32,
+        s_rcof: Int32,
+        s_tot: Int32,
+        r0: Int32,

+    @cute.jit
+    def _rank_slot(self, t: Int32, k: Int32, s_ids: Int32, s_mask: Int32, s_off: Int32):
+        ex = Int32(lds32(s_ids + (t * self.top_k + k) * 4))

+        rank = rank + popc(lds32(s_mask + (ex * MASKW + t // 32) * 4) & low)

+    @cute.jit
+    def _front_entry(
+        self,
+        ids: Int64,
+        cnt: Int64,
+        M: Int32,
+        tid: Int32,
+        warp: Int32,
+        lane: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        s_ids: Int32,
+        s_mask: Int32,
+        s_cnt: Int32,
+        s_off: Int32,
+        s_rcb: Int32,
+        s_tot: Int32,
+        r0: Int32,

+        for i in cutlass.range(tid, self.experts, NTHR, unroll=1):
+            sts32(s_cnt + i * 4, Uint32(0))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not self.ids_mode):  # noqa: SIM102
+            if tid == 0:
+                self._wait_rows(cnt, M)
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        for i in cutlass.range(tid, M * self.top_k, NTHR, unroll=1):

+            pe = cute.make_rmem_tensor((self.per_lane,), Int32)
+            pr = cute.make_rmem_tensor((self.per_lane,), Int32)
+            se = Int32(0)
+            sr = Int32(0)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.per_lane):
+                c = Int32(lds32(s_cnt + (lane * self.per_lane + j) * 4))
+                pe[j] = se
+                pr[j] = sr
+                se = se + c + (8 - c % 8) % 8
+                sr = sr + (c + RC_ROWS - 1) // RC_ROWS
+            ie = se
+            ir = sr
+            for sh in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                oe = shfl_up_i32(ie, 1 << sh)
+                orr = shfl_up_i32(ir, 1 << sh)
+                if lane >= (1 << sh):

+        for ex in cutlass.range(tid, self.experts, NTHR, unroll=1):

+            o = Int32(lds32(s_off + ex * 4))
+            rb = Int32(lds32(s_rcb + ex * 4))

+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        return Int32(lds32(s_tot))

+    @cute.jit
+    def _promote_w(
+        self,
+        N: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        d: cute.Tensor,
+        base: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        acc: cute.Tensor,
+        wsa: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Acc += d * 2^(e_row - 127): one k32 group's UE8M0 weight scale."""
+        w = lds_u16(wsa)
+        f_lo = e8m0_to_f32(w)
+        f_hi = e8m0_to_f32(w >> Uint32(8))
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(N // 8):
+            acc[4 * i] = acc[4 * i] + d[base + 4 * i] * f_lo
+            acc[4 * i + 1] = acc[4 * i + 1] + d[base + 4 * i + 1] * f_lo
+            acc[4 * i + 2] = acc[4 * i + 2] + d[base + 4 * i + 2] * f_hi
+            acc[4 * i + 3] = acc[4 * i + 3] + d[base + 4 * i + 3] * f_hi

+    @cute.jit
+    def _wgmma_k32_f16(
+        self,
+        N: cutlass.Constexpr,

+        R: Int32,
+        lane: Int32,
+        d: cute.Tensor,
+        base: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ):
+        """One k32 scale group = two k16 f16 wgmmas. ``wt``: the k32's first 1 KB
+        W8A16 block of this warpgroup's 64 rows (the second is 2 KB further)."""
+        vals = [d[base + i] for i in range(N // 2)]
+        for kb in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            w = lds64(wt + kb * 2048 + lane * 32 + 8 * R)
+            lo_g, hi_g = cvt_e4m3_word(w[0])

+        NS = self.ns1
+        g = lane // 4

+                        tma_load_4d(st + G1_W, tw13, 0, p, 0, e * KT1 + kt, fb, pol)
+                        tma_load_4d(
+                            st + G1_WS, ts13, 0, p, 0, e * (2 * KT1) + 2 * kt, fb, pol
+                        )
+                    mbar_arrive(hb + stage * 8)
+                    kst = kst + 1
+                stage = stage + 1
+                if stage == NS:
+                    stage = Int32(0)
+                    phase = phase ^ 1
+            skip = Int32(0)
+        # drain: every GEMM1 stage released before ring 2 reuses the smem
+        for j in cutlass.range(NS, unroll=1):
+            mbar_wait(empty + stage * 8, phase ^ 1)
+            stage = stage + 1
+            if stage == NS:
+                stage = Int32(0)
+                phase = phase ^ 1

+    # ================================================================ signal warp
+    @cute.jit
+    def _b_loop(
+        self,
+        x: Int64,
+        M: Int32,
+        xg: Int64,
+        xsg: Int64,
+        xgs: Int64,
+        xsgs: Int64,
+        cnt: Int64,
+        btgt: Int32,
+        NCH: Int32,
+        tsh: Int32,
+        sbase: Int32,
+        full: Int32,
+        hb: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        bid: Int32,
+    ):
+        """B tiles (activations) of every GEMM1 stage, in ring order, after the
+        rows are published."""
+        NS = self.ns1
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        pol = evict_first_policy()
+        ready = Int32(0)
+        stage = Int32(0)
+        phase = Int32(0)
+        running = Int32(1)
+        while running == 1:
+            mbar_wait(hb + stage * 8, phase)
+            st = sbase + stage * SB1
+            fb = full + stage * 8
+            ch = Int32(lds32(st + HDR1))
+            if ch == END:
+                running = Int32(0)
+                cute.arch.sync_warp()
+                if lane == 0:
+                    mbar_arrive(fb)
+            else:
+                tl, h = _ch_tile(ch, NCH, tsh)
+                rc = tl // NPAIR
+                js_u = Int32(lds32(st + HDR1 + 4))
+                if Int32(lds32(tab + rc * 4)) == E_SH:
+                    self._xconv_sh(
+                        st,
+                        x,
+                        M,
+                        Int32(lds32(tab + (RC_CAP + rc) * 4)),
+                        Int32(lds32(tab + (2 * RC_CAP + rc) * 4)),
+                        js_u,
+                        lane,
+                    )
+                    fence_proxy_async_smem()
+                    cute.arch.sync_warp()
+                    if lane == 0:
+                        mbar_arrive(fb)
+                else:
+                    if lane == 0:
+                        if ready == 0:
+                            self._wait_rows(cnt, btgt)
+                            fence_proxy_async_global()
+                            ready = Int32(1)
+                        self._issue_b1(st, fb, tab, rc, js_u, xg, xsg, xgs, xsgs, pol)
+                        mbar_arrive(fb)
+                    cute.arch.sync_warp()
+                stage = stage + 1
+                if stage == NS:
+                    stage = Int32(0)
+                    phase = phase ^ 1
