+    @cute.jit
+    def _signal(
+        self,
+        sync: Int64,
+        stamp: Int32,
+        NCH: Int32,
+        tsh: Int32,
+        s_done: Int32,
+        s_fin: Int32,
+        s_fdone: Int32,
+        clist: Int32,
+        flist: Int32,
+    ):
+        processed = Int32(0)
+        fin_n = Int32(0)
+        ended = Int32(0)
+        while ended == 0:
+            avail = _min_count(s_done)
+            if avail > processed:
+                fence_gpu()
+                for s in cutlass.range(processed, avail, unroll=1):
+                    ch = Int32(lds32(clist + (s % CL) * 4))
+                    if ch == END:
+                        ended = Int32(1)
+                    else:
+                        tile, hh = _ch_tile(ch, NCH, tsh)
+                        nch = _tile_nch(tile, NCH, tsh)
+                        if hh == nch - 1:
+                            sts32(flist + (fin_n % CL) * 4, Uint32(tile))
+                            fin_n = fin_n + 1
+                        else:
+                            red_add_gpu(sync + _i64(S_TILE + tile) * 4, 1)
+                processed = avail
+            else:
+                nanosleep(20)
+        # this CTA finalizes the tiles whose last k-chunk it ran, once the
+        # other chunks are counted
+        for i in cutlass.range(fin_n, unroll=1):
+            tile = Int32(lds32(flist + (i % CL) * 4))
+            nch = _tile_nch(tile, NCH, tsh)
+            while ld_acquire_i32(sync + _i64(S_TILE + tile) * 4) < nch - 1:
+                nanosleep(32)
+            stg_i32(sync + _i64(S_TILE + tile) * 4, 0)
+        sts_release(s_fin, fin_n | FIN_FLAG)
+        if fin_n > 0:
+            while _min_count(s_fdone) == 0:
+                nanosleep(20)
+            fence_gpu()
+            for i in cutlass.range(fin_n, unroll=1):
+                tile = Int32(lds32(flist + (i % CL) * 4))
+                red_add_gpu(sync + _i64(S_READY + tile // NPAIR) * 4, 1)
+            red_add_gpu(sync + _i64(S_ALL) * 4, fin_n)
+
+    # ================================================================ SwiGLU
+    @cute.jit
+    def _swiglu_one(
+        self,
+        NQ: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        HM: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        tile: Int32,
+        c0: Int32,
+        ncol: Int32,
+        mask: Uint32,
+        NCH: Int32,
+        tsh: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        g2: Int64,
+        part: Int64,
+        iq: Int64,
+        isc: Int64,
+        iqs: Int64,
+        iscs: Int64,
+        lane: Int32,
+    ):
+        """SwiGLU + FP8 of columns c0 + 8 q (q < NQ) of one finalized tile, with
+        the partial loads of all NQ columns (<= HM k-chunks each) issued at once."""
+        rc = tile // NPAIR
+        p = tile % NPAIR
+        e = Int32(lds32(tab + rc * 4))
+        off = Int32(lds32(tab + (RC_CAP + rc) * 4))
+        f2 = Float32(1.0)
+        if e != E_SH:
+            f2 = ldg_f32(g2 + _i64(e) * 4) * Float32(64.0)
+        nch = _tile_nch(tile, NCH, tsh)
+        pv = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4 * NQ * HM,), Float32)
+        for qq in cutlass.range_constexpr(NQ):
+            cq = c0 + 8 * qq
+            if cq < ncol:  # noqa: SIM102
+                if ((mask >> Uint32(cq)) & Uint32(1)) != Uint32(0):
+                    for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(HM):
+                        if h < nch:
+                            a = (
+                                part
+                                + (
+                                    (_i64(_tile_ch(tile, Int32(h), NCH, tsh)) * 32 + cq)
+                                    * 128
+                                    + 2 * lane
+                                )
+                                * 4
+                            )
+                            gv = ldg_cg_f32x2(a)
+                            uv = ldg_cg_f32x2(a + 64 * 4)
+                            b = (qq * HM + h) * 4
+                            pv[b] = gv[0]
+                            pv[b + 1] = gv[1]
+                            pv[b + 2] = uv[0]
+                            pv[b + 3] = uv[1]
+        for qq in cutlass.range_constexpr(NQ):
+            cc = c0 + 8 * qq
+            okc = Int32(0)
+            if cc < ncol:  # noqa: SIM102
+                if ((mask >> Uint32(cc)) & Uint32(1)) != Uint32(0):
+                    okc = Int32(1)
+            if okc == 1:
+                ent = off + cc
+                b0 = qq * HM * 4
+                g0 = pv[b0]
+                g1 = pv[b0 + 1]
+                u0 = pv[b0 + 2]
+                u1 = pv[b0 + 3]
+                for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, HM):
+                    if h < nch:
+                        g0 = g0 + pv[b0 + 4 * h]
+                        g1 = g1 + pv[b0 + 4 * h + 1]
+                        u0 = u0 + pv[b0 + 4 * h + 2]
+                        u1 = u1 + pv[b0 + 4 * h + 3]
+                if e == E_SH:
+                    g0 = round_bf16(g0)
+                    g1 = round_bf16(g1)
+                    u0 = round_bf16(u0)
+                    u1 = round_bf16(u1)
+                h0 = swiglu(g0, u0, Float32(SWIGLU_LIMIT))
+                h1 = swiglu(g1, u1, Float32(SWIGLU_LIMIT))
+                amax = fmax(fabs(h0), fabs(h1))
+                for sh in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                    amax = fmax(amax, shfl_xor_f32(amax, 1 << sh))
+                amax = fmax(amax, Float32(1e-12))
+                inv = Float32(448.0) * rcp(amax)
+                q = cvt_e4m3x4(h0 * inv, h1 * inv, Float32(0.0), Float32(0.0))
+                if e == E_SH:
+                    # shared GEMM2 B (f16): [k96 v][t/8][k8 (12)][t%8][16 B]
+                    kq = 64 * p + 2 * lane
+                    dst = (
+                        iqs
+                        + ((_i64(kq // 96) * NGS + ent // 8) * 12 + (kq % 96) // 8)
+                        * 128
+                        + (ent % 8) * 16
+                        + (kq % 8) * 2
+                    )
+                    stg_u32(dst, f16x2(round_bf16(h0), round_bf16(h1)))
+                else:
+                    p3 = p // K2S
+                    ki = p % K2S
+                    r = 2 * lane
+                    dst = (
+                        iq
+                        + (((_i64(p3) * NG + ent // 8) * K2S + ki) * 4 + r // 16) * 128
+                        + (ent % 8) * 16
+                        + r % 16
+                    )
+                    stg_u16(dst, q & Uint32(0xFFFF))
+                    if lane == 0:
+                        stg_f32(
+                            isc + ((_i64(p3) * ENTP + ent) * K2S + ki) * 4,
+                            amax * Float32(1.0 / 448.0) * f2,
+                        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _cluster_tile(
+        self,
+        tile: Int32,
+        hq: Int32,
+        rc: Int32,
+        e: Int32,
+        ncol: Int32,
+        mask: Uint32,
+        f13: Float32,
+        acc: cute.Tensor,
+        r0: Int32,
+        t: Int32,
+        lane: Int32,
+        warp: Int32,
+        tid: Int32,
+        cph: Int32,
+        slot: Int32,
+        cfull: Int32,
+        cfree: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        g2: Int64,
+        iq: Int64,
+        isc: Int64,
+        sync: Int64,
+    ) -> Int32:
+        """Routed tile, k-half ``hq`` = cluster rank (N = 8 columns). Rank 1:
+        partial -> rank 0's ``slot`` (DSMEM). Rank 0: own + rank-1 partial ->
+        SwiGLU + FP8 intermediate of the tile, then publish it (S_READY)."""
+        G = (ncol + 7) // 8
+        if hq == 1:
+            mbar_wait_cluster(cfree, cph)
+            rs = mapa(slot, 0)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                if j < G:
+                    for i2 in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        cc = 8 * j + 2 * t + i2
+                        st_cluster_f32(rs + (cc * 128 + r0) * 4, acc[4 * j + i2] * f13)
+                        st_cluster_f32(
+                            rs + (cc * 128 + r0 + 8) * 4, acc[4 * j + 2 + i2] * f13
+                        )
+            mbar_arrive_cluster(mapa(cfull, 0))
+        else:
+            mbar_wait_cluster(cfull, cph)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                if j < G:
+                    for i2 in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        cc = 8 * j + 2 * t + i2
+                        a0 = slot + (cc * 128 + r0) * 4
+                        a1 = slot + (cc * 128 + r0 + 8) * 4
+                        v0 = acc[4 * j + i2] * f13 + lds_f32(a0)
+                        v1 = acc[4 * j + 2 + i2] * f13 + lds_f32(a1)
+                        sts_f32(a0, v0)
+                        sts_f32(a1, v1)
+            named_barrier(3, NCT)
+            for q2 in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                self._cluster_swiglu(
+                    warp + 8 * q2, tile, rc, e, ncol, mask, lane, slot, tab, g2, iq, isc
+                )
+            fence_proxy_async_global()
+            named_barrier(3, NCT)
+            if tid == 0:
+                mbar_arrive_cluster(mapa(cfree, 1))
+                fence_gpu()
+                red_add_gpu(sync + _i64(S_READY + rc) * 4, 1)
+                red_add_gpu(sync + _i64(S_ALL) * 4, 1)
+        return cph ^ 1
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _cluster_swiglu(
+        self,
+        cc: Int32,
+        tile: Int32,
+        rc: Int32,
+        e: Int32,
+        ncol: Int32,
+        mask: Uint32,
+        lane: Int32,
+        slot: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        g2: Int64,
+        iq: Int64,
+        isc: Int64,
+    ):
+        if cc < ncol:  # noqa: SIM102
+            if ((mask >> Uint32(cc)) & Uint32(1)) != Uint32(0):
+                p = tile % NPAIR
+                off = Int32(lds32(tab + (RC_CAP + rc) * 4))
+                f2 = ldg_f32(g2 + _i64(e) * 4) * Float32(64.0)
+                a = slot + (cc * 128 + 2 * lane) * 4
+                g0 = lds_f32(a)
+                g1 = lds_f32(a + 4)
+                u0 = lds_f32(a + 256)
+                u1 = lds_f32(a + 260)
+                h0 = swiglu(g0, u0, Float32(SWIGLU_LIMIT))
+                h1 = swiglu(g1, u1, Float32(SWIGLU_LIMIT))
+                amax = fmax(fabs(h0), fabs(h1))
+                for sh in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                    amax = fmax(amax, shfl_xor_f32(amax, 1 << sh))
+                amax = fmax(amax, Float32(1e-12))
+                inv = Float32(448.0) * rcp(amax)
+                q = cvt_e4m3x4(h0 * inv, h1 * inv, Float32(0.0), Float32(0.0))
+                ent = off + cc
+                p3 = p // K2S
+                ki = p % K2S
+                r = 2 * lane
+                dst = (
+                    iq
+                    + (((_i64(p3) * NG + ent // 8) * K2S + ki) * 4 + r // 16) * 128
+                    + (ent % 8) * 16
+                    + r % 16
+                )
+                stg_u16(dst, q & Uint32(0xFFFF))
+                if lane == 0:
+                    stg_f32(
+                        isc + ((_i64(p3) * ENTP + ent) * K2S + ki) * 4,
+                        amax * Float32(1.0 / 448.0) * f2,
+                    )
+
+    # ================================================================ GEMM2
+    @cute.jit
+    def _consume2(
+        self,
+        N: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        stage: Int32,
+        phase: Int32,
+        sbase: Int32,
+        full: Int32,
+        empty: Int32,
+        blk: Int32,
+        R: Int32,
+        lane: Int32,
+        acc: cute.Tensor,
+        d: cute.Tensor,
+        af: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        NS = self.ns2
+        t = lane % 4
+        g = lane // 4
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(N // 2):
+            acc[i] = Float32(0.0)
+        for js in cutlass.range(NPAIR // K2S, unroll=1):
+            if js > 0:
+                mbar_wait(full + stage * 8, phase)
+            st = sbase + stage * SB2
+            qa = cute.make_rmem_tensor((6,), Uint32)
+            qb = cute.make_rmem_tensor((6,), Uint32)
+            ws0 = st + G2_WS + blk * 64 + 8 * g + 2 * R
+            _dq_load(st + G2_W + blk * 2048, ws0, ws0 + 128, lane, R, qa)
+            for ki in cutlass.range_constexpr(K2S):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(ki < K2S - 1):
+                    wn = st + G2_W + ((ki + 1) * 2 + blk) * 2048
+                    wsn = st + G2_WS + (2 * (ki + 1)) * 128 + blk * 64 + 8 * g + 2 * R
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(ki % 2 == 0):
+                        _dq_load(wn, wsn, wsn + 128, lane, R, qb)
+                    else:
+                        _dq_load(wn, wsn, wsn + 128, lane, R, qa)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(ki % 2 == 0):
+                    _dq_conv(qa, af)
+                else:
+                    _dq_conv(qb, af)
+                _wgmma_k64(
+                    N, st + G2_B + ki * 512, 1536, af, d, (ki % 2) * 16, Int32(0)
+                )
+                wgmma_commit()
+                if cutlass.const_expr(ki > 0):
+                    wgmma_wait_n(1)
+                    _pin(N, d, ((ki - 1) % 2) * 16)
+                    _promote(
+                        N, d, ((ki - 1) % 2) * 16, acc, st + G2_AS + (ki - 1) * 4, 12, t
+                    )
+            wgmma_wait_n(0)
+            _pin(N, d, ((K2S - 1) % 2) * 16)
+            _promote(N, d, ((K2S - 1) % 2) * 16, acc, st + G2_AS + (K2S - 1) * 4, 12, t)
+            cute.arch.sync_warp()
+            if lane == 0:
+                mbar_arrive(empty + stage * 8)
+            stage = stage + 1
+            if stage == NS:
+                stage = Int32(0)
+                phase = phase ^ 1
+        return stage, phase
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _issue_b2(
+        self,
+        it: Int32,
+        js: Int32,
+        st: Int32,
+        fb: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        iq: Int64,
+        isc: Int64,
+        iqs: Int64,
+        iscs: Int64,
+        pol: Int64,
+    ):
+        rc = it // NBP2
+        off = Int32(lds32(tab + (RC_CAP + rc) * 4))
+        G = (Int32(lds32(tab + (2 * RC_CAP + rc) * 4)) + 7) // 8
+        if Int32(lds32(tab + rc * 4)) == E_SH:
+            bulk_g2s(
+                st + G2_B, iqs + (_i64(js) * NGS + off // 8) * 1536, G * 1536, fb, pol
+            )
+        else:
+            bulk_g2s(
+                st + G2_B, iq + (_i64(js) * NG + off // 8) * 1536, G * 1536, fb, pol
+            )
+            bulk_g2s(st + G2_AS, isc + (_i64(js) * ENTP + off) * 12, G * 96, fb, pol)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _wait_tiles(
+        self,
+        sync: Int64,
+        rc: Int32,
+        p_lo: Int32,
+        p_hi: Int32,
+        stamp: Int32,
+        all_ok: Int32,
+        n_tiles_all: Int32,
+    ) -> Int32:
+        """All 9 intermediate tiles of row chunk rc are finalized; returns 1 once
+        every tile of the call is (then no more polls are needed)."""
+        if all_ok == 0:
+            if ld_acquire_i32(sync + _i64(S_ALL) * 4) >= n_tiles_all:
+                all_ok = Int32(1)
+            else:
+                while ld_acquire_i32(sync + _i64(S_READY + rc) * 4) < NPAIR:
+                    nanosleep(32)
+            fence_proxy_async_global()
+        return all_ok
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _stage_pairs(self, e: Int32, js: Int32):
+        """First / last intermediate pair (64 columns) a GEMM2 stage reads."""
+        p_lo = js * K2S
+        p_hi = js * K2S + K2S - 1
+        if e == E_SH:
+            p_lo = (3 * js) // 2
+            p_hi = (3 * js + 2) // 2
+        return p_lo, p_hi
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _produce2(
+        self,
+        tw2: Int64,
+        ts2: Int64,
+        sw2: Int64,
+        ss2: Int64,
+        iq: Int64,
+        isc: Int64,
+        iqs: Int64,
+        iscs: Int64,
+        cnt: Int64,
+        sync: Int64,
+        stamp: Int32,
+        n_rc: Int32,
+        sbase: Int32,
+        full: Int32,
+        empty: Int32,
+        tab: Int32,
+        nblk: Int32,
+        bid: Int32,
+    ):
+        """w2 tiles of the first NS2 stages at once; each stage's B tile after
+        its row chunk's intermediate is published."""
+        NS = self.ns2
+        SPI = NPAIR // K2S
+        pol = evict_first_policy()
+        n_items = n_rc * NBP2
+        work = cnt + C_WORK2 * 4
+        nxt = bid
+        k = Int32(0)
+        flushed = Int32(0)
+        last_rc = Int32(-1)
+        last_p = Int32(-1)
+        all_ok = Int32(0)
+        running = Int32(1)
+        while running == 1:
+            it = nxt
+            if it < n_items:
+                nxt = nblk + atom_add_relaxed(work, 1)
+            rc = it // NBP2
+            nbp = it % NBP2
+            e = Int32(lds32(tab + rc * 4))
+            G = (Int32(lds32(tab + (2 * RC_CAP + rc) * 4)) + 7) // 8
+            nst = Int32(SPI)
+            if e == E_SH:
+                nst = Int32(SH_V2)
+            if it >= n_items:
+                nst = Int32(1)
+                running = Int32(0)
+            for js in cutlass.range(nst, unroll=1):
+                stage = k % NS
+                phase = (k // NS) % 2
+                mbar_wait(empty + stage * 8, phase ^ 1)
+                st = sbase + stage * SB2
+                fb = full + stage * 8
+                if running == 0:
+                    sts32(st + HDR2, Uint32(END))
+                    mbar_arrive_expect_tx(fb, 0)
+                else:
+                    sts32(st + HDR2, Uint32(it))
+                    sts32(st + HDR2 + 4, Uint32(js))
+                    if e == E_SH:
+                        mbar_arrive_expect_tx(fb, 12288 + 384 + G * 1536)
+                        tma_load_3d(st + G2_W, sw2, 0, 2 * nbp, 6 * js, fb, pol)
+                        tma_load_2d(st + G2_WS, ss2, 128 * nbp, 3 * js, fb, pol)
+                    else:
+                        mbar_arrive_expect_tx(fb, G2_B + G * 1536 + G * 96)
+                        tma_load_3d(
+                            st + G2_W, tw2, 0, 2 * nbp, e * 10 + js * K2S, fb, pol
+                        )
+                        tma_load_3d(
+                            st + G2_WS, ts2, 0, nbp, e * 20 + js * 2 * K2S, fb, pol
+                        )
+                    if flushed == 1:

+        acc: cute.Tensor,
+        y: Int64,
+        off: Int32,
+        ncol: Int32,
+        mask: Uint32,
+        n0: Int32,
+        lane: Int32,
+    ):

+        t = lane % 4

+            s_lo = acc[4 * j + 1]
+            s_hi = acc[4 * j + 3]
+            if odd == 1:
+                s_lo = acc[4 * j]
+                s_hi = acc[4 * j + 2]

+            "setp.gt.f32 p, $1, 0f41A00000;\nselp.f32 l, $1, l, p;\n"

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The FlashMLA sparse decode of a Hopper executor step.
+
+It is the decode branch of ``DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention.forward_mqa`` on
+per-step tables that the layers share (``FlashMlaTables``):
+
+- One FlashMLA tile-scheduler plan per layer type (compress ratio). The stock
+  decode keeps one per type in each SWA KV-cache group's metadata, so every
+  group plans each type again. A plan depends only on the batch shape and on
+  the SWA and compressed top-k lengths, which every group derives alike from
+  the batch (one window, one set of sequence lengths, one index top-k), so the
+  first layer of a type plans for all of them.
+- One global top-k table per ``sparse_index_key``. Compressed layers that share
+  an index source map its top-k indices through the same compressed block
+  table, so the first of them builds the table and the others reuse it. The
+  map also reads a SWA group's token-to-request map and token validity, which
+  every group derives alike from the batch.
+
+Both are built on the forward stream and issue no collective. Steps of up to
+``mla_small.MAX_ROWS`` uniform rows run the small-batch kernels instead
+(``mla_small``), which need neither.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import compute_global_topk_indices_and_lens
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.sparse_mla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.flashmla import (
+    FlashMLASchedMeta,
+    flash_mla_with_kvcache,
+    get_mla_metadata,
+)
+
+from ...flashmla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
+from ..attention.sparse_mla import sparse_index_key
+from .mla_small import SmallMlaDecode
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_swa import DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata
+
+
+class FlashMlaTables:
+    """The tile-scheduler plans and global top-k tables of one decode step."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, attns: list[DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention], small: bool = True
+    ) -> None:
+        self.keys = {attn: sparse_index_key(attn) for attn in attns}
+        self._plans: dict[int, FlashMLASchedMeta] = {}
+        self._tables: dict[str, tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+        self.small = SmallMlaDecode(attns, attns[0].attn_sink.device) if small else None
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        """Forget the previous step's plans and tables, and choose the step's
+        path."""
+        self._plans.clear()
+        self._tables.clear()
+        if self.small is not None:
+            self.small.start()
+
+    def join(self) -> None:
+        """Wait for the small path's SWA unions; the FlashMLA tables are built
+        on the forward stream."""
+        if self.small is not None:
+            self.small.join()
+
+    def plan(self, attn: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention) -> FlashMLASchedMeta:
+        """The step's plan of ``attn``'s layer type, planned by the first
+        decode launch that takes it."""
+        plan = self._plans.get(attn.compress_ratio)
+        if plan is None:
+            plan = self._plans[attn.compress_ratio] = get_mla_metadata()[0]
+        return plan
+
+    def global_topk(
+        self,
+        attn: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention,
+        swa_metadata: "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata",
+        attn_metadata: DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """``compute_global_topk_indices_and_lens`` of a compressed layer, on
+        the step's shared tables."""
+        key = self.keys[attn]
+        table = self._tables.get(key)
+        if table is None:
+            num_tokens = swa_metadata.num_decode_tokens
+            assert attn.topk_indices_buffer is not None
+            assert swa_metadata.is_valid_token is not None
+            table = compute_global_topk_indices_and_lens(
+                attn.topk_indices_buffer[:num_tokens],
+                swa_metadata.token_to_req_indices,
+                attn_metadata.block_table[: swa_metadata.num_decodes],
+                attn_metadata.block_size // attn.compress_ratio,
+                swa_metadata.is_valid_token[:num_tokens],
+                launch_pdl=True,
+            )
+            # A key's layers are consecutive, and the next index source
+            # overwrites the top-k indices: drop the previous key's table.
+            self._tables = {key: table}
+        return table
+
+
+class FlashMlaDecode:
+    """``forward_mqa`` of a pure-decode step on the shared tables."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tables: FlashMlaTables) -> None:
+        self.tables = tables
+
+    def chain_step(self, rows: int) -> bool:
+        """Whether this step's MLA runs the small path, whose combine can also
+        apply the inverse RoPE (``run_rotated``)."""
+        from . import attn_chain
+
+        small = self.tables.small
+        return small is not None and small.query_len > 0 and rows <= attn_chain.MAX_ROWS
+
+    def run_rotated(
+        self,
+        attn: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``attn``'s sparse MLA of ``q`` on the small path, inverse-rotated:
+        the ``wo_a`` input [rows, groups, heads per group * 512]."""
+        by_layer = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        assert isinstance(by_layer, dict)
+        swa_metadata = cast(
+            "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata", by_layer[attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix]
+        )
+        attn_metadata = None
+        if attn.compress_ratio != 0:
+            assert attn.compressed_cache_prefix is not None
+            attn_metadata = cast(
+                DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata, by_layer[attn.compressed_cache_prefix]
+            )
+        small = self.tables.small
+        assert small is not None
+        rotated = small.run(attn, q, None, swa_metadata, attn_metadata, positions)
+        assert rotated is not None
+        return rotated
+
+    def run(
+        self, attn: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention, q: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> None:
+        """Write ``attn``'s sparse MLA of ``q`` (padded heads) into ``out``."""
+        by_layer = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        assert isinstance(by_layer, dict)
+        swa_metadata = cast(
+            "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata", by_layer[attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix]
+        )
+        assert swa_metadata.num_prefills == 0
+        num_tokens = swa_metadata.num_decode_tokens
+        if num_tokens == 0:
+            return
+        attn_metadata = None
+        if attn.compress_ratio != 0:
+            assert attn.compressed_cache_prefix is not None
+            attn_metadata = cast(
+                DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata, by_layer[attn.compressed_cache_prefix]
+            )
+        small = self.tables.small
+        if small is not None and small.query_len:
+            small.run(attn, q, out, swa_metadata, attn_metadata)
+            return
+        kv_cache = indices = lens = None
+        if attn_metadata is not None:
+            global_indices, lens = self.tables.global_topk(
+                attn, swa_metadata, attn_metadata
+            )
+            indices = global_indices.view(num_tokens, 1, -1)
+            kv_cache = attn._compressed_kv_cache().unsqueeze(-2)
+        flash_mla_with_kvcache(
+            q=q[:num_tokens].unsqueeze(1),
+            k_cache=attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache.unsqueeze(-2),
+            block_table=None,
+            head_dim_v=512,
+            tile_scheduler_metadata=self.tables.plan(attn),
+            cache_seqlens=None,
+            is_fp8_kvcache=True,
+            indices=swa_metadata.decode_swa_indices,
+            topk_length=swa_metadata.decode_swa_lens,
+            softmax_scale=attn.scale,
+            attn_sink=attn.attn_sink,
+            extra_k_cache=kv_cache,
+            extra_indices_in_kvcache=indices,
+            extra_topk_length=lens,
+            out=out[:num_tokens].unsqueeze(1),
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The steps of a Hopper executor layer: the executor's attention, MoE and
+boundary steps with the Hopper kernel choices (``kernels``)."""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.tilelang import mhc_post_tilelang
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import MoEOutput
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import QuantizedActivation
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.attention import DeepseekV4Indexer
+
+from ..attention.step import AttentionStep, StepMla, StepTables
+from ..boundary.boundary import Boundaries, BoundaryState
+from ..moe.step import MoEStep
+from . import attn_chain, fused_indexer, kernels
+from .moe import HopperLowBatchMoE
+from .sparse_mla import FlashMlaDecode
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_swa import DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata
+
+    from ...flashmla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
+    from ...model import DeepseekV4MoE
+    from ..boundary.all_reduce import BoundaryAllReduce
+    from ..runtime.decode import DecodeStep
+    from .fused_indexer import FusedDecodeIndexer
+
+
+class HopperAttentionStep(AttentionStep):
+    """``AttentionStep`` of a ``DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention`` layer: the same
+    side-stream schedule, on the Hopper projections (``linears``), with
+    ``wo_b`` publishing into ``all_reduce`` where its kernel can. Its layer
+    input is BF16 (the dense linears are weight-only W8A16), so ``quant`` is
+    always None.
+
+    Steps on the small-batch MLA of up to ``attn_chain.MAX_ROWS`` rows run the
+    early-trigger small kernels (``attn_chain``): the q/kv RMSNorm with the KV
+    insert, the query RoPE, and the MLA combine with the inverse RoPE, whose
+    output ``wo_a`` reads directly."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        attn: "DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention",
+        tables: StepTables,
+        mla: StepMla,
+        all_reduce: "BoundaryAllReduce",
+        fused_indexer: "FusedDecodeIndexer | None" = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(attn, tables, mla, None, False, None, None)
+        self.linears = kernels.AttentionLinears.of(attn)
+        self.all_reduce = all_reduce
+        self.fused_indexer = fused_indexer
+        self.chain = attn_chain.applies(attn) and isinstance(mla, FlashMlaDecode)
+        self._chain_step = False
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        quant: QuantizedActivation | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        rows = x.shape[0]
+        mla = self.mla
+        if not (
+            self.chain
+            and isinstance(mla, FlashMlaDecode)
+            and mla.chain_step(rows)
+            and self.linears.wo_a is not None
+            and self.linears.wo_a.serves(rows)
+        ):
+            return super().run(x, quant, positions, step)
+        attn = self.attn
+        by_layer = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        assert isinstance(by_layer, dict)
+        swa_metadata = cast(
+            "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata", by_layer[attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix]
+        )
+        qr_kv, kv_score, indexer_weights = self._input_projections(x, None, step)
+        qr = attn_chain.norm_kv_insert(attn, qr_kv, positions, swa_metadata)
+        self._chain_step = True
+        try:
+            q, index_q, index_q_scale, index_weights = self._prepare(
+                qr, None, None, kv_score, indexer_weights, positions, step
+            )
+        finally:
+            self._chain_step = False
+        indexer = attn.indexer
+        if indexer is not None and index_q is not None:
+            assert index_weights is not None
+            self._indexer(indexer, x, index_q, index_q_scale, index_weights, step)
+        rotated = mla.run_rotated(attn, q, positions)
+        return kernels.wo_b(
+            attn, self.linears, self.linears.wo_a(rotated), self.all_reduce
+        )
+
+    def _indexer(
+        self,
+        indexer: DeepseekV4Indexer,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        index_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> None:
+        fused = self.fused_indexer
+        op = indexer.indexer_op
+        if fused is not None and index_q_scale is None and fused_indexer.applies(op):
+            by_layer = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+            assert isinstance(by_layer, dict)
+            metadata: Any = by_layer.get(op.k_cache.prefix)
+            swa: Any = by_layer[self.attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix]
+            query_len = swa.max_decode_query_len
+            if swa.num_decode_tokens == swa.num_decodes * query_len and fused.serves(
+                metadata, query_len
+            ):
+                # The side-stream table builds read the top-k indices.
+                self.tables.join()
+                fused(op, index_q, index_weights, metadata, query_len)
+                return
+        super()._indexer(indexer, x, index_q, index_q_scale, index_weights, step)
+
+    def _q_rope_kv_insert(
+        self, q: torch.Tensor, kv: torch.Tensor | None, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self._chain_step:
+            return attn_chain.q_rope(self.attn, q, positions)
+        return super()._q_rope_kv_insert(q, kv, positions)
+
+    def _wqa_wkv(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        quant: QuantizedActivation | None,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert quant is None
+        return kernels.wqa_wkv(self.attn, self.linears, x)
+
+    def _wq_b(
+        self,
+        qr: torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation,
+        qr_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert isinstance(qr, torch.Tensor) and qr_scale is None
+        return kernels.wq_b(self.attn, self.linears, qr)
+
+    def _index_wq_b(
+        self,
+        indexer: DeepseekV4Indexer,
+        qr: torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation,
+        qr_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert isinstance(qr, torch.Tensor) and qr_scale is None
+        return kernels.index_wq_b(indexer, self.linears, qr)
+
+    def _o_proj(
+        self, out: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor, step: "DecodeStep"
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return kernels.o_proj(self.attn, self.linears, out, positions, self.all_reduce)
+
+
+class HopperMoEStep(MoEStep):
+    """``MoEStep`` on the Hopper MoE (``kernels.moe``)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ffn: "DeepseekV4MoE", max_rows: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__(ffn, None, max_rows)
+        self.shared = kernels.SharedMlp.of(ffn)
+        self.routed = HopperLowBatchMoE.of(ffn)
+        # The low-batch kernel leaves the top-k reduction to the boundary.
+        self.deferrable = self.routed is not None
+
+    def run(
+        self, x: torch.Tensor, input_ids: torch.Tensor | None, step: "DecodeStep"
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | MoEOutput:
+        return kernels.moe(self.ffn, self.shared, self.routed, x, input_ids)
+
+
+class HopperBoundaries(Boundaries):
+    """``Boundaries`` whose residual-only boundaries (before an Engram layer and
+    after the last layer) also reduce a finalized sublayer output in the fused
+    kernel. No other TP collective then runs on the forward stream while the
+    Engram WKV issues its all-gathers on its side stream.
+
+    Steps above the fused kernel's capacity take the stock decode's unfused
+    boundary: the TP all-reduce and the mHC post, after which the mHC pre
+    computes the layer input itself."""
+
+    def post_only(
+        self, state: BoundaryState, fuse_partial: bool = False
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        residual, _ = self._reduce(state, None, None, None)
+        return residual
+
+    def _reduce(
+        self,
+        state: BoundaryState,
+        pre: torch.Tensor | None,
+        norm: RMSNorm | None,
+        mxfp8_out: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        if state.residual.shape[0] <= self.all_reduce.capacity:
+            return super()._reduce(state, pre, norm, mxfp8_out)
+        assert mxfp8_out is None and isinstance(state.pending, torch.Tensor)
+        x = get_tp_group().all_reduce(state.pending)
+        return mhc_post_tilelang(x, state.residual, state.post, state.comb), None

+"""Top-k finalize of the DeepSeek-V4.1 low-batch routed-expert GEMMs in CuTe DSL.
+
+GEMM2 (``routed_expert_gemm_cute.py``) leaves one unweighted BF16 row per
+routed slot. Layers whose MoE output is not handed to the fused all-reduce +
+mHC (the DSpark draft's, which finalize in the layer) reduce those rows here::
+
+    out[t, h] = BF16( sum_k  w[t, k] * rows[permuted[t, k], h] )
+
+with the FP32 sum accumulated in slot order ``k = 0..top_k-1`` by fused
+multiply-adds and slots whose permuted row is -1 skipped. This is the
+arithmetic of FlashInfer's TRT-LLM-gen finalize kernel for small batches (one
+thread per output value, grid ``hidden / 256 x tokens``), so the output matches
+its ``do_finalize=True`` path given the same GEMM2 rows.
+"""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import BFloat16, Float32, Int32
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import T, dsl_user_op
+
+HIDDEN = 5120
+TILE = 8  # GEMM2 rows per routed slot, at most
+MAX_TOP_K = 8  # routed slots per token, at most
+FINALIZE_THREADS = 256  # one thread per output value
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def fma_rn(a, b, c, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    """``a * b + c`` rounded once (``fma.rn.f32``)."""
+    return Float32(
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            T.f32(),
+            [Float32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for v in (a, b, c)],
+            "fma.rn.f32 $0, $1, $2, $3;",
+            "=f,f,f,f",
+            has_side_effects=False,
+            is_align_stack=False,
+            asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+            loc=loc,
+            ip=ip,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+class RoutedExpertFinalize:

+"""The specialized decode of the DSpark draft model.
+
+With DSpark speculative decoding, a few extra DeepSeek-V4.1 decoder layers
+(``DSparkDeepseekV4Model``) draft the next tokens from the target's hidden
+states after every target step, in CUDA graphs of their own. ``DraftDecode``
+runs those layers for the FULL-graph pure decode steps, as ``SpecializedDecode``
+runs the target's, through the same per-layer steps and on the kernels and
+streams the target's executor owns: the fused all-reduce + mHC kernel and its
+Lamport mailbox, the publishing ``wo_b`` GEMM and the mHC side stream. The
+draft runs between target steps on the same stream, so sharing them needs no
+synchronization beyond the stream order.
+
+The draft's layers differ from the target's in ways the steps take as
+parameters:
+
+- the first layer takes ``[n, hc, H]`` streams, the embedding expanded to the
+  hc copies, through its own mHC pre (``Boundaries.first``);
+- the layers are built as stock layers, which reduce ``wo_b`` and the MoE
+  themselves; ``AttentionStep`` projects ``wo_b`` without that all-reduce and
+  ``MoEStep`` runs the runner's body, so both stay TP-partial for the next
+  boundary's fused kernel;
+- each layer finalizes its MoE (the fused kernel's finalize is built for the
+  target's top-k): up to ``LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS`` rows on the low-batch GEMMs,
+  without the target's fused front, and the finalize kernel;
+- the last boundary reduces that plain tensor in the fused kernel's
+  residual-only variant, and the streams are collapsed with the last pre-mix,
+  before the final norm, which ``compute_logits`` applies.
+
+The layers are sliding-window only: they share each SWA KV-cache group's
+sparse-index table (``SparseIndexTables``), and the sparse MLA keeps the stock
+decode's wide non-causal window of the draft tokens.
+
+The target's model state builds this executor after the target's, on every TP
+rank in the same order, and warms its GEMMs up with the target's. Every
+forward that ``plan`` refuses runs the stock layers.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.forward_context import is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.triton import hc_collapse_triton
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops.query_quant import can_fuse_query_quant
+

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CUDA graphs of the device work between the target forward and the DSpark
+draft step on decode steps, for model states that offer them.
+
+A model state opts in with a true ``post_forward_cudagraphs`` attribute; the
+others, and runners without a DSpark speculator, keep the eager region.
+
+After the target model's FULL CUDA graph, a decode step runs about two dozen
+small kernels eagerly before the draft step's graphs: the hidden-state gather
+and LM head (with its all-gather), the rejection sampler, the request-state
+update (``postprocess_sampled``) and the draft input preparation. At small
+batch sizes their launches leave the GPU idle between them. For uniform decode
+steps whose sampling is fixed by the batch shape, this region is captured in
+one CUDA graph per shape and replayed.
+
+Eligibility is decided per step on the host, from state every tensor-parallel
+rank holds identically. Anything that changes the op sequence or reads host
+state at run time keeps the eager path: logprobs, prompt logprobs, grammar,
+logits processing, prefill and non-uniform batches. Sampling draws come from
+per-request seeds and positions, not from a host-advanced generator, so a
+replay draws what the eager kernels draw.
+
+A graph reads its inputs at the addresses it was captured with. The per-step
+tensors ``prepare_inputs`` allocates (``idx_mapping``, ``cu_num_logits``, the
+expanded mapping and positions, ``logits_indices``) are copied into buffers
+owned here, in one launch. So are the host-backed temperature, seed and
+prefill-length buffers, which rotate through a small pool of host buffers; the
+region reads the copies. The other inputs are persistent runner, sampler and
+speculator buffers or the target graph's outputs. The key holds the address of
+each of them, so a moved buffer captures a new graph instead of replaying a
+stale one. The first step of a key runs eagerly (it compiles kernels and warms
+up allocations), the second captures, later ones replay.
+
+The graph outputs (sampled tokens, counts) are static. The previous step's
+async output copy may still read them on the output copy stream, so a replay
+waits for that stream first.
+
+The draft context work that reads only the target hidden states (the combined
+hidden states and, if the draft model supports it, every draft layer's context
+KV projection) is forked onto the speculator's side stream after the LM head
+and joined at the end of the draft input preparation, so it runs beside
+sampling. Eager or captured, the fork and join are stream waits inside the
+region.
+
+The graphs are captured while serving, into a pool of their own that the
+startup memory profile does not see. They share that pool, so it holds about
+one region's temporaries at the largest batch (mostly its logits).
+"""
+

+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from dataclasses import replace

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Fused kernels for DSpark's sequential Markov sampling.
+
+Per draft position, the eager loop runs an embedding lookup, the Markov bias
+GEMM, a logits add, index/copy glue, the Gumbel kernel, an argmax reduction, a
+gather and a scatter into ``draft_tokens``. The fused path keeps the bias GEMM
+and replaces the rest with one kernel per position.
+
+Each program of ``_markov_sample_kernel`` handles one ``(request, vocab block)``
+pair. It forms the logits as ``base_logits[:, i] + bias`` does (fp32 add rounded
+to the result dtype), writes them to the draft-logits cache and takes the
+block's Gumbel-max winner with ``gumbel_noised_argmax``, as ``gumbel_sample``
+does. The last program to finish a request (an arrival counter) reduces the
+block winners with ``torch.argmax`` semantics, stores the draft token and copies
+its Markov embedding row into the next position's GEMM input. The noise is a
+hash of ``(seed, draft step, position, token)``, the step mixed into the seed
+as ``gumbel_sample`` does for a cached column, so the fused loop draws exactly
+the eager loop's tokens.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel import gumbel_noised_argmax, spec_step_seed
+
+# gumbel_sample's block size, so block winners and tie-breaking agree.
+_BLOCK_SIZE = 1024
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _markov_embed_anchor_kernel(
+    input_ids_ptr,
+    query_per_req,
+    weight_ptr,
+    weight_stride,
+    embed_ptr,
+    embed_stride,
+    rank,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    token = tl.load(input_ids_ptr + req * query_per_req).to(tl.int64)
+    r = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+    row = tl.load(weight_ptr + token * weight_stride + r, mask=r < rank)
+    tl.store(embed_ptr + req * embed_stride + r, row, mask=r < rank)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["step"])
+def _markov_sample_kernel(
+    # [num_reqs, num_steps, vocab_size]
+    base_logits_ptr,
+    base_stride_0,
+    base_stride_1,
+    # [num_reqs, vocab_size]
+    bias_ptr,
+    bias_stride,
+    step,
+    num_steps,
+    # [num_reqs * num_steps], ordered (req, step)
+    idx_mapping_ptr,
+    sample_pos_ptr,
+    temp_ptr,
+    seeds_ptr,
+    # [max_num_reqs, num_steps, vocab_size]
+    logits_cache_ptr,
+    logits_cache_stride_0,
+    logits_cache_stride_1,
+    # [max_num_reqs, num_steps]
+    draft_tokens_ptr,
+    draft_tokens_stride,
+    # [vocab_size, rank] and [num_reqs, rank]
+    embed_weight_ptr,
+    embed_weight_stride,
+    embed_ptr,
+    embed_stride,
+    rank,
+    # [max_num_reqs, BLOCK_P] scratch and [max_num_reqs] arrival counters
+    partial_max_ptr,
+    partial_idx_ptr,
+    counter_ptr,
+    vocab_size,
+    num_blocks,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_P: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_FP64: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_NEXT: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    block_idx = tl.program_id(1)
+    block = block_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    mask = block < vocab_size
+
+    base = tl.load(
+        base_logits_ptr + req * base_stride_0 + step * base_stride_1 + block,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=float("-inf"),
+    )
+    bias = tl.load(bias_ptr + req * bias_stride + block, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    # The eager add's rounding: fp32 sum, rounded once to the cache dtype.
+    logits = (base.to(tl.float32) + bias.to(tl.float32)).to(
+        logits_cache_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    )
+
+    row = req * num_steps + step
+    req_state_idx = tl.load(idx_mapping_ptr + row).to(tl.int64)
+    is_valid_req = req_state_idx >= 0
+    tl.store(
+        logits_cache_ptr
+        + req_state_idx * logits_cache_stride_0
+        + step * logits_cache_stride_1
+        + block,
+        logits,
+        mask=mask & is_valid_req,
+    )
+    temp = tl.load(temp_ptr + req_state_idx, mask=is_valid_req, other=0.0).to(
+        tl.float32
+    )
+    seed = tl.load(seeds_ptr + req_state_idx, mask=is_valid_req, other=0)
+    seed = spec_step_seed(seed, step)
+    # sample_pos is the predicted token's position; the draw is keyed by the
+    # position before it.
+    pos = tl.load(sample_pos_ptr + row) - 1
+    value, idx = gumbel_noised_argmax(
+        logits.to(tl.float32),
+        block,
+        mask,
+        seed,
+        pos,
+        temp,
+        IS_DRAFTING=True,
+        USE_FP64=USE_FP64,
+        APPLY_TEMPERATURE=True,
+    )
+    tl.store(partial_max_ptr + req * BLOCK_P + block_idx, value)
+    tl.store(partial_idx_ptr + req * BLOCK_P + block_idx, block_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + idx)
+
+    # The last block of this request to arrive finishes the reduction. The
+    # barrier orders every thread's partial stores before the release.
+    tl.debug_barrier()
+    arrival = tl.atomic_add(counter_ptr + req, 1, sem="acq_rel", scope="gpu")
+    if arrival != num_blocks - 1:
+        return
+
+    p = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_P)
+    p_mask = p < num_blocks
+    values = tl.load(
+        partial_max_ptr + req * BLOCK_P + p,
+        mask=p_mask,
+        other=float("-inf"),
+        volatile=True,
+    )
+    # torch.argmax semantics: the first NaN if any, else the first maximum.
+    is_nan = values != values
+    first_nan = tl.min(tl.where(is_nan, p, BLOCK_P))
+    best = tl.max(tl.where(is_nan, float("-inf"), values))
+    first_max = tl.min(tl.where(p_mask & (values == best), p, BLOCK_P))
+    winner = tl.where(first_nan < BLOCK_P, first_nan, first_max)
+    token = tl.load(partial_idx_ptr + req * BLOCK_P + winner, volatile=True).to(
+        tl.int64
+    )
+    tl.store(draft_tokens_ptr + req * draft_tokens_stride + step, token)
+    if HAS_NEXT:
+        r = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+        embed_row = tl.load(
+            embed_weight_ptr + token * embed_weight_stride + r, mask=r < rank
+        )
+        tl.store(embed_ptr + req * embed_stride + r, embed_row, mask=r < rank)
+    tl.atomic_xchg(counter_ptr + req, 0, sem="acq_rel", scope="gpu")
+
+
+class DSparkFusedMarkovSampler:
+    """Persistent buffers and launchers of the fused Markov sampling loop.
+
+    ``embed_weight`` is the ``[vocab, rank]`` table ``markov_embed`` looks up.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        max_num_reqs: int,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        embed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        use_fp64: bool,
+    ):
+        assert embed_weight.dim() == 2 and embed_weight.stride(1) == 1
+        device = embed_weight.device
+        self.embed_weight = embed_weight
+        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
+        self.use_fp64 = use_fp64
+        self.num_blocks = triton.cdiv(vocab_size, _BLOCK_SIZE)
+        self.block_p = triton.next_power_of_2(self.num_blocks)
+        self.rank = embed_weight.shape[1]
+        self.block_r = triton.next_power_of_2(self.rank)

+        self.markov_embed = torch.zeros(
+            max_num_reqs, self.rank, dtype=embed_weight.dtype, device=device

+            max_num_reqs,
+            self.block_p,
+            dtype=torch.float64 if use_fp64 else torch.float32,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        self.partial_idx = torch.empty(
+            max_num_reqs, self.block_p, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        # Zero between launches: the last block of each request resets it.
+        self.counter = torch.zeros(max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    def embed_anchor(
+        self, input_ids: torch.Tensor, query_per_req: int, num_reqs: int
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:

+
+    def sample_step(

+            idx_mapping,

+            logits_cache.stride(1),
+            draft_tokens,

+            self.embed_weight.stride(0),
+            embed,
+            embed.stride(0),
+            self.rank,
+            self.partial_max,
+            self.partial_idx,
+            self.counter,
+            vocab_size,
+            self.num_blocks,
+            BLOCK_SIZE=_BLOCK_SIZE,
+            BLOCK_P=self.block_p,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DSpark Markov sampling with the Markov head sharded by vocabulary.
+
+After the DSpark backbone produces the base logits of its ``N`` draft
+positions, the draft tokens are drawn one position at a time: the bias
+``markov_head @ markov_embed[previous token]`` (``[V, r]`` by ``[r]``; 66 MB of
+BF16 for DeepSeek-V4.1) is added to the position's logits and the token is
+sampled from the result. The fused path (``fused_sample.py``) runs a replicated
+bias GEMM and one sampling kernel per position, so every tensor-parallel rank
+streams the whole head ``N`` times.
+
+Here one cooperative kernel per rank (``sharded_markov_cute.py``, CuTe DSL)
+runs the whole chain. Rank ``k`` of ``world`` owns rows
+``[k V / world, (k + 1) V / world)`` of the head and keeps them in registers
+for the launch, so the head is read once; the ranks agree on each position's
+winner by exchanging one 64-bit ``(score, index)`` key per rank, request row
+and position through a mailbox in symmetric memory. A call samples up to 8
+request rows (4 with 8 ranks), the columns of the tensor-core MMA. Padding rows
+(negative request-state index) are inert, as in the fused path.
+
+Per call::
+
+    Triton noise kernel   gumbel[i, v] of this rank's vocabulary shard (the
+          |               fused path's hash), drawn on a side stream while the
+          v               draft LM head runs
+    chain kernel, step i  logit = cache_round(base + bf16(head . embed[p]))
+                          local cache and every peer's staging <- logit
+                          key = max over the shard of (logit / T + gumbel, index)
+                          mailbox exchange -> winner p = draft_tokens[i]
+    chain kernel, tail    cache <- the peers' shards from the local staging
+
+The draws reproduce the fused path (same noise, rounding, temperature division
+and ``torch.argmax`` tie-breaking) except for the bias reduction order before
+its BF16 rounding, so a bias element can differ from cuBLAS's in its last bit.
+
+The exchange is a cross-rank spin wait inside the draft step (and its FULL
+CUDA graph): every rank must launch the kernel the same number of times.
+Installation depends on configuration only and is agreed across the group, and
+the per-call choice depends only on the padded batch shape, which tensor
+parallelism keeps identical across ranks; a rank that diverges hangs.
+"""
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch.distributed import ProcessGroup
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel import (
+    _DRAFT_NOISE_SALT,
+    _log1p_neg_stable,
+    murmur3_uniform32,
+    spec_step_seed,
+)
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+RANK_DIM = 256
+WARPS = 16  # per CTA (sharded_markov_cute.py)
+MAX_STEPS = 8
+MAX_RANKS = 8
+MAX_ROWS = 8  # MMA columns
+MAX_VOCAB = (1 << 17) - 1  # the candidate key's index field
+STAGING_OFFSET = 16384  # bytes; the mailbox records come first
+CONTROL_WORDS = 256  # int32 control words (sharded_markov_cute.py)
+NOISE_BLOCK = 1024
+DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)  # base logits and cache
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _shard_noise_kernel(
+    noise_ptr,
+    idx_mapping_ptr,
+    sample_pos_ptr,
+    seeds_ptr,
+    vocab_offset,
+    vocab_local,
+    num_steps,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Draft Gumbel noise of this rank's vocabulary shard for one (request row,
+    position), as ``gumbel_noised_argmax`` draws it (fp32, drafting salt) with
+    the draft step mixed into the seed. Samples are ordered (row, step)."""
+    sample = tl.program_id(0)
+    cols = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = cols < vocab_local
+    req_state_idx = tl.load(idx_mapping_ptr + sample).to(tl.int64)
+    is_valid_req = req_state_idx >= 0
+    seed = tl.load(seeds_ptr + req_state_idx, mask=is_valid_req, other=0)
+    seed = spec_step_seed(seed, sample % num_steps)
+    pos = tl.load(sample_pos_ptr + sample) - 1 + _DRAFT_NOISE_SALT
+    u = murmur3_uniform32(seed, pos, vocab_offset + cols)
+    gumbel_noise = -tl.log(-_log1p_neg_stable(u))
+    tl.store(noise_ptr + sample * vocab_local + cols, gumbel_noise, mask=mask)
+
+
+@cache
+def _kernel(
+    device_index: int, steps: int, base_dtype: torch.dtype, cache_dtype: torch.dtype
+):
+    """The CuTe DSL chain kernel compiled for a device, ``steps`` draft
+    positions and the base-logits and cache dtypes. Its 512-thread CTA fits one
+    per SM, and a call never launches more CTAs than the device has SMs, so the
+    cooperative grid is always co-resident."""
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+    from .sharded_markov_cute import ShardedMarkovSample
+
+    types = {torch.bfloat16: cutlass.BFloat16, torch.float32: cutlass.Float32}
+    address = Int64(0)
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(
+            ShardedMarkovSample(steps, types[base_dtype], types[cache_dtype]),
+            *[address] * 7,
+            Int32(1),
+            *[address] * 10,
+            *[Int32(1)] * 5,
+            address,
+            Int32(1),
+            make_fake_stream(),
+        )
+
+
+def _all_ranks_true(group: ProcessGroup | None, value: bool) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``value`` holds on every rank of ``group`` (CPU collective)."""
+    if group is None:
+        return value
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(value)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+def unsupported_reason(
+    world: int,
+    vocab_size: int,
+    num_steps: int,
+    embed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    head_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> str | None:
+    """Why the sharded sampler cannot serve this configuration, or None. It
+    depends on configuration only, so every rank reaches the same answer."""
+    if world not in (1, 2, 4, MAX_RANKS):
+        return f"a tensor-parallel size of {world}"
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability(embed_weight.device) < (10, 0):
+        return "a GPU older than SM100"
+    if not 1 <= num_steps <= MAX_STEPS:
+        return f"{num_steps} draft positions"
+    if vocab_size > MAX_VOCAB or vocab_size % (16 * world) != 0:
+        return f"a vocabulary of {vocab_size} for {world} ranks"
+    if cache_dtype not in DTYPES:
+        return f"a {cache_dtype} draft-logits cache"
+    if vocab_size // world * cache_dtype.itemsize % 16 != 0:
+        return "a vocabulary shard that is not 16-byte aligned"
+    for name, weight in (("embedding", embed_weight), ("head", head_weight)):
+        if (
+            weight.dim() != 2
+            or weight.shape[0] < vocab_size
+            or weight.shape[1] != RANK_DIM
+            or weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or not weight.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            return f"a Markov {name} that is not contiguous BF16 [V, {RANK_DIM}]"
+    return None
+
+
+class DSparkShardedMarkovSampler:
+    """Persistent buffers, peer mappings and launchers of the sharded chain.
+
+    ``embed_weight`` ``[V, 256]`` and the replicated ``head_weight``
+    ``[V, 256]`` are BF16; this rank keeps a view of its head rows. ``group``
+    is the CPU group of the tensor-parallel ranks (None for one rank).
+    ``timeout_ms`` bounds every cross-rank wait with a trap (0: no bound, a
+    debugging aid). Batches of up to ``max_rows`` request rows, CUDA-graph
+    padding included, take the sharded chain.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        embed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        head_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        num_steps: int,
+        cache_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        group: ProcessGroup | None,
+        max_num_reqs: int,
+        timeout_ms: int = 0,
+    ):
+        device = embed_weight.device
+        self.group = group
+        self.rank = dist.get_rank(group) if group is not None else 0
+        self.world = dist.get_world_size(group) if group is not None else 1
+        reason = unsupported_reason(
+            self.world, vocab_size, num_steps, embed_weight, head_weight, cache_dtype
+        )
+        if reason is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"sharded Markov sampling does not support {reason}")
+        self.device = device
+        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
+        self.num_steps = num_steps
+        self.cache_dtype = cache_dtype
+        self.timeout_ns = int(timeout_ms) * 1_000_000
+        self.vocab_local = vocab_size // self.world
+        self.vocab_offset = self.rank * self.vocab_local
+        self.embed_weight = embed_weight
+        self.head_shard = head_weight[
+            self.vocab_offset : self.vocab_offset + self.vocab_local
+        ]
+        self.ctas = min(
+            torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).multi_processor_count,
+            triton.cdiv(self.vocab_local // 16, WARPS),
+        )
+        # The exchange gives each (request row, rank) pair one lane of a warp.
+        self.max_rows = max(1, min(MAX_ROWS, 32 // self.world, max_num_reqs))
+        self.noise = torch.empty(
+            self.max_rows * num_steps,
+            self.vocab_local,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        self.control = torch.zeros(CONTROL_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        # Compile before the collective set-up, so that a build failure cannot
+        # leave peers waiting, and before any CUDA graph capture.
+        index = device.index
+        self.device_index = (
+            torch.accelerator.current_device_index() if index is None else index
+        )
+        failure = None
+        try:
+            for base_dtype in DTYPES:
+                _kernel(self.device_index, num_steps, base_dtype, cache_dtype)
+        except Exception as error:  # any compile failure is agreed on below
+            failure = error
+        if not _all_ranks_true(group, failure is None):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"kernel set-up failed: {failure or 'on another rank'}")
+        # Mailbox records, then the staging logits of two launch parities.
+        size = STAGING_OFFSET + (
+            2 * self.max_rows * num_steps * vocab_size * cache_dtype.itemsize
+        )
+        self._peer_buffer, peer_pointers = self._allocate_peer_buffer(size)
+        self.peers = torch.tensor(peer_pointers, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self._noise_stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device)
+
+    def _allocate_peer_buffer(self, size: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, list[int]]:
+        """The zeroed mailbox and staging buffer and every rank's mapping of it
+        (symmetric memory for more than one rank)."""
+        if self.group is None:
+            buffer = torch.zeros(size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.device)
+            return buffer, [buffer.data_ptr()]
+        import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+
+        # The rendezvous is collective: agree on the allocation first, so that
+        # a rank that failed it cannot leave its peers waiting there.
+        buffer = None
+        try:
+            buffer = symm_mem.empty(size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.device)
+        except RuntimeError as error:
+            logger.warning("Symmetric memory allocation failed: %s", error)
+        if not _all_ranks_true(self.group, buffer is not None):
+            raise RuntimeError("symmetric memory allocation failed on a rank")
+        assert buffer is not None
+        self._handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(buffer, self.group.group_name)
+        pointers = [
+            self._handle.get_buffer(peer, (size,), torch.uint8, 0).data_ptr()
+            for peer in range(self.world)
+        ]
+        buffer.zero_()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize(self.device)
+        dist.barrier(group=self.group)
+        return buffer, pointers
+
+    def supports_batch(self, num_reqs: int) -> bool:
+        """Whether a batch of ``num_reqs`` request rows (padding included) can
+        take the sharded chain; the same on every rank."""
+        return 1 <= num_reqs <= self.max_rows
+
+    def supports(self, num_reqs: int, base_logits: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        """Whether a call with these ``[num_reqs, num_steps, V]`` base logits,
+        or this rank's ``[num_reqs, num_steps, V / world]`` shard of them,
+        takes the sharded chain. Depends on shapes and dtypes only."""
+        return (
+            self.supports_batch(num_reqs)
+            and base_logits.dim() == 3
+            and tuple(base_logits.shape[:2]) == (num_reqs, self.num_steps)
+            and base_logits.shape[2] in (self.vocab_size, self.vocab_local)
+            and base_logits.dtype in DTYPES
+            and base_logits.stride(2) == 1
+        )
+
+    def accepts_shard(self, shard: tuple[int, int] | None) -> bool:
+        """Whether, on every rank, ``shard`` (the first column and width of
+        the draft LM head's local logits) is this rank's vocabulary shard. A
+        CPU collective: a rank that skipped the LM head's all-gather would
+        leave its peers waiting in it."""
+        return _all_ranks_true(
+            self.group, shard == (self.vocab_offset, self.vocab_local)
+        )
+
+    def fork_noise(
+        self, idx_mapping: torch.Tensor, sample_pos: torch.Tensor, seeds: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> None:
+        """Draw this call's noise on a side stream after the current stream's
+        work so far; ``join_noise`` must follow before ``sample``. The noise
+        depends on the seeds and positions only, not on the chain."""
+        num_sample = idx_mapping.numel()
+        assert num_sample <= self.noise.shape[0]
+        self._noise_stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self._noise_stream):
+            grid = (num_sample, triton.cdiv(self.vocab_local, NOISE_BLOCK))
+            _shard_noise_kernel[grid](
+                self.noise,
+                idx_mapping,
+                sample_pos,
+                seeds,
+                self.vocab_offset,
+                self.vocab_local,
+                self.num_steps,
+                BLOCK=NOISE_BLOCK,
+            )
+
+    def join_noise(self) -> None:
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device).wait_stream(self._noise_stream)
+
+    def sample(
+        self,
+        base_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        query_per_row: int,
+        idx_mapping: torch.Tensor,
+        temperature: torch.Tensor,
+        logits_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        draft_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Draw every request row's draft tokens into ``draft_tokens[row]`` and
+        the full-vocabulary logits of rows with a request state into
+        ``logits_cache[idx_mapping]``, with the noise of ``fork_noise``.
+
+        ``base_logits`` is ``[rows, num_steps, V]`` or this rank's
+        ``[rows, num_steps, V / world]`` shard; row ``r``'s anchor token is
+        ``input_ids[r * query_per_row]``; ``idx_mapping`` is the
+        ``[rows * num_steps]`` request-state row (negative for padding).
+        """
+        rows = base_logits.shape[0]
+        assert self.supports(rows, base_logits)
+        assert idx_mapping.numel() == rows * self.num_steps
+        assert idx_mapping.dtype == torch.int64
+        assert input_ids.dtype == torch.int32 and temperature.dtype == torch.float32
+        assert draft_tokens.dtype == torch.int64 and draft_tokens.stride(1) == 1
+        assert logits_cache.dtype == self.cache_dtype
+        assert logits_cache.size(2) >= self.vocab_size and logits_cache.stride(2) == 1
+        element = logits_cache.element_size()
+        assert logits_cache.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+        assert logits_cache.stride(0) * element % 16 == 0
+        assert logits_cache.stride(1) * element % 16 == 0
+        import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+        from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+
+        # The column of this rank's first vocabulary entry in base_logits.
+        full_vocab = base_logits.shape[2] == self.vocab_size
+        base_column = self.vocab_offset if full_vocab else 0
+        kernel = _kernel(
+            self.device_index, self.num_steps, base_logits.dtype, self.cache_dtype
+        )
+        kernel(
+            Int64(base_logits.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(base_logits.stride(0)),
+            Int64(base_logits.stride(1)),
+            Int64(base_column),
+            Int64(self.embed_weight.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(self.head_shard.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(input_ids.data_ptr()),
+            Int32(query_per_row),
+            Int64(idx_mapping.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(temperature.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(self.noise.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(logits_cache.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(logits_cache.stride(0)),
+            Int64(logits_cache.stride(1)),
+            Int64(draft_tokens.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(draft_tokens.stride(0)),
+            Int64(self.peers.data_ptr()),
+            Int64(self.control.data_ptr()),
+            Int32(self.rank),
+            Int32(self.world),
+            Int32(self.vocab_local),
+            Int32(rows),
+            Int32(self.max_rows),
+            Int64(self.timeout_ns),
+            Int32(self.ctas),
+            cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device).cuda_stream),
+        )
+
+
+def make_sharded_sampler(
+    embed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    head_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    vocab_size: int,
+    num_steps: int,
+    cache_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    group: ProcessGroup | None,
+    max_num_reqs: int,
+) -> DSparkShardedMarkovSampler | None:
+    """The sampler on every rank of ``group``, or None on every rank (logged).
+
+    Every rank must call this: the decision and the set-up are agreed with CPU
+    collectives. ``head_weight`` None means this rank cannot install it.
+    """
+    world = dist.get_world_size(group) if group is not None else 1
+    reason: str | None = "a Markov head the model does not share"
+    if head_weight is not None:
+        reason = unsupported_reason(
+            world, vocab_size, num_steps, embed_weight, head_weight, cache_dtype
+        )
+    if not _all_ranks_true(group, reason is None):
+        logger.info(
+            "Sharded DSpark Markov sampling is off: %s.",
+            reason or "another tensor-parallel rank cannot use it",
+        )
+        return None
+    assert head_weight is not None
+    sampler = None
+    try:
+        sampler = DSparkShardedMarkovSampler(
+            embed_weight,
+            head_weight,
+            vocab_size,
+            num_steps,
+            cache_dtype,
+            group,
+            max_num_reqs,
+        )
+    except RuntimeError as error:
+        logger.warning("Sharded DSpark Markov sampling set-up failed: %s", error)
+    if not _all_ranks_true(group, sampler is not None):
+        return None
+    assert sampler is not None
+    logger.info(
+        "Sharded DSpark Markov sampling on %d ranks for batches of up to %d "
+        "request rows.",
+        sampler.world,
+        sampler.max_rows,
+    )
+    return sampler
